00010: async function bootstrapSnapshot(lottery = "PT_RIO") {
00011: 
00012:   const draws = await fetchAllDrawsWithPrizes({
00013:     lottery,
00014:     pageSize: 500,
00015:   });
00016: 
00017:   console.log("Draws carregados:", draws.length);
00018: 
00019:   const built = buildRanking(draws);
00020: 
00021:   const ranking = Array.isArray(built?.ranking)
00022:     ? built.ranking
00023:     : [];

00025:   const rankingScored = applyScoreEngine(ranking);
00026: 
00027:   await writeStatisticsSnapshot({
00028:     uf: lottery,
00029:     scope: "dashboard_full",
00030:     data: {
00031:       version: 1,
00032:       totalDraws: built.totalDraws,
00033:       uniqueDays: built.uniqueDays,
00034:       totalOcorrencias: built.totalOcorrencias,
00035:       countMode: built.countMode,
00036:       ranking,
00037:       rankingScored,
00038:       top3: rankingScored.slice(0,3),
00039:       integrityIssues: built.integrityIssues || [],
00040:       generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
00041:     },
00042:   });
00043: 
00044:   return {
00045:     draws: draws.length,
00046:     ranking: ranking.length,
00047:     top3: rankingScored.slice(0,3),
00048:   };

00003: const { getAdminDb } = require("./statisticsEngine");
00004: 
00005: function normalizeLottery(lottery) {
00006:   return String(lottery || "PT_RIO").trim().toUpperCase();
00007: }
00008: 
00009: function normalizeGrupo(v) {
00010:   const n = Number(v);
00011:   return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 25 ? n : null;
00012: }
00013: 
00014: function normalizePosition(v) {
00015:   const n = Number(v);
00016:   return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 10 ? n : null;
00017: }
00018: 
00019: async function fetchPrizesForDrawRef(drawRef) {
00020:   const snap = await drawRef.collection("prizes").get();
00021: 
00022:   return snap.docs
00023:     .map((doc) => {
00024:       const data = doc.data() || {};
00025:       return {
00026:         id: doc.id,
00027:         ...data,
00028:         grupo: normalizeGrupo(data.grupo),
00029:         position: normalizePosition(data.position),
00030:       };
00031:     })
00032:     .filter((p) => p.grupo && p.position);
00033: }
00034: 
00035: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, concurrency, mapper) {
00036:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00037:   const out = new Array(arr.length);
00038:   let index = 0;
00039: 
00040:   async function worker() {
00041:     while (index < arr.length) {
00042:       const i = index++;
00043:       out[i] = await mapper(arr[i], i);
00044:     }
00045:   }
00046: 
00047:   await Promise.all(
00048:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, worker)
00049:   );
00050: 
00051:   return out;
00052: }
00053: 
00054: async function fetchAllDrawsWithPrizes({
00055:   lottery = "PT_RIO",
00056:   pageSize = 250,
00057:   prizeConcurrency = 12,
00058: } = {}) {
00059:   const db = getAdminDb();
00060:   const lk = normalizeLottery(lottery);
00061: 
00062:   const admin = require("firebase-admin");
00063:   const DOC_ID = admin.firestore.FieldPath.documentId();
00064: 
00065:   const draws = [];
00066:   let lastDoc = null;
00067:   let page = 0;
00068: 
00069:   while (true) {
00070:     page++;
00071: 
00072:     let q = db
00073:       .collection("draws")
00074:       .where("lottery_key", "==", lk)
00075:       .orderBy("ymd", "asc")
00076:       .orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc")
00077:       .limit(pageSize);
00078: 
00079:     if (lastDoc) q = q.startAfter(lastDoc);
00080: 
00081:     console.log(`[BOOTSTRAP] Buscando página ${page}...`);
00082: 
00083:     const snap = await q.get();
00084: 
00085:     if (snap.empty) break;
00086: 
00087:     const pageDraws = await mapWithConcurrency(
00088:       snap.docs,
00089:       prizeConcurrency,
00090:       async (doc) => {
00091:         const data = doc.data() || {};
00092:         const prizes = await fetchPrizesForDrawRef(doc.ref);
00093: 
00094:         return {
00095:           id: doc.id,
00096:           drawId: doc.id,
00097:           ...data,
00098:           prizes,
00099:         };
00100:       }
00101:     );
00102: 
00103:     draws.push(...pageDraws);
00104: 
00105:     console.log(
00106:       `[BOOTSTRAP] Página ${page}: ${snap.docs.length} draws | total=${draws.length}`
00107:     );
00108: 
00109:     lastDoc = snap.docs[snap.docs.length - 1];
00110: 
00111:     if (snap.docs.length < pageSize) break;
00112:   }
00113: 
00114:   return draws;
00115: }
00116: 
00117: module.exports = {
00118:   fetchAllDrawsWithPrizes,
00119: };

00033:  * - cache por consulta
00034:  * - paginação
00035:  * - consultas paralelas
00036:  * - filtros compostos
00037:  */
00038: async function queryOccurrences({
00039:   lotteryKey,
00040:   entityType,
00041:   entityValue,
00042:   filters = {},
00043:   limitSamples = 20,
00044: } = {}) {
00045: 
00046:   if (!lotteryKey) throw new Error("lotteryKey obrigatório");
00047:   if (!entityType) throw new Error("entityType obrigatório");
00048: 
00049:   const db = getDb();
00050: 
00051:   let q = db.collection("draws")
00052:     .where("lottery_key","==",lotteryKey);
00053: 
00054:   if (filters.closeHour) {
00055:     q = q.where("close_hour","==",filters.closeHour);
00056:   }
00057: 
00058:   const draws = await q.get();
00059: 
00060:   const cache = {
00061:     draws: draws.size,
00062:     analyzed: 0,
00063:     matched: 0,
00064:   };
00065: 
00066: 
00067:   const wantedWeekday = normalizeWeekday(filters.weekday);
00068: 
00069:   let drawsAnalyzed = 0;
00070:   let occurrences = 0;
00071:   const matches = [];
00072: 
00073:   for (const draw of draws.docs) {
00074: 
00075:     const data = draw.data();
00076: 
00077:     if (wantedWeekday !== null) {
00078:       if (getWeekday(data.ymd) !== wantedWeekday) {
00079:         continue;
00080:       }
00081:     }
00082: 
00083:     drawsAnalyzed++;
00084:     cache.analyzed++;
00085: 
00086: 
00087:     let prizesQuery = draw.ref.collection("prizes");
00088: 
00089:     if (filters.position != null) {
00090:       prizesQuery = prizesQuery.where("position","==",Number(filters.position));
00091:     }
00092: 
00093:     const prizes = await prizesQuery.get();
00094: 
00095:     for (const p of prizes.docs) {
00096: 
00097:       const prize = p.data();
00098: 
00099:       const ok =
00100:         String(prize[entityType] ?? "")
00101:           .toLowerCase()
00102:           ==
00103:         String(entityValue)
00104:           .toLowerCase();
00105: 
00106:       if (!ok) continue;
00107: 
00108:       occurrences++;
00109:       cache.matched++;
00110: 
00111: 
00112:       if (matches.length < limitSamples) {
00113: 
00114:         matches.push({
00115: 
00116:           drawId: draw.id,
00117: 
00118:           ymd: data.ymd,
00119: 
00120:           closeHour: data.close_hour,
00121: 
00122:           lotteryKey: data.lottery_key,
00123: 
00124:           position: prize.position,
00125: 
00126:           animal: prize.animal,
00127: 
00128:           grupo: prize.grupo,
00129: 
00130:           dezena: prize.dezena,
00131: 
00132:           centena: prize.centena,
00133: 
00134:           milhar: prize.milhar,
00135: 
00136:         });
00137: 
00138:       }
00139: 
00140:     }
00141: 
00142:   }
00143: 
00144:   return {
00145: 
00146:     cache,
00147: 
00148:     statistics: {
00149: 
00150:       drawsAnalyzed,
00151: 
00152:       occurrences,
00153: 
00154:       percentage:
00155:         drawsAnalyzed
00156:           ? Number((occurrences*100/drawsAnalyzed).toFixed(2))
00157:           : 0
00158: 
00159:     },
00160: 
00161:     matches
00162: 
00163:   };
00164: 
00165: }
00166: 
00167: module.exports = {
00168: 
00169:   queryOccurrences,
00170: 
00171: };

00008: function normalizeLotteryKey(value) {
00009:   const s = String(value || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00010:   if (s === "RJ" || s === "RIO" || s === "PT-RIO" || s === "PT_RIO") return "PT_RIO";
00011:   if (s === "FED" || s === "FEDERAL") return "FEDERAL";
00012:   return s || "PT_RIO";
00013: }
00014: 
00015: function pad2(n) {
00016:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
00017: }
00018: 
00019: function makePredictionRunId({ lotteryKey, date, closeHour, source = "manual" }) {

00056:     .collection(RUNS)
00057:     .doc(runId)
00058:     .collection(SUB);

00060:   for (const prediction of predictions) {
00061:     const ref = parent.doc();

00064:       ...prediction,
00065:       id: ref.id,
00066:       updatedAt: new Date(),

00194:     const a = Math.max(1, Number(m[1]));
00195:     const b = Math.max(1, Number(m[2]));
00196:     const lo = Math.min(a, b);
00197:     const hi = Math.max(a, b);
00198:     const positions = [];
00199:     for (let i = lo; i <= hi; i += 1) positions.push(i);
00200:     return { positions, maxPos: hi };
00201:   }
00202: 
00203:   const parts = raw
00204:     .split(",")
00205:     .map((s) => Number(String(s).trim()))
00206:     .filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1);
00207: 
00208:   if (!parts.length) return { positions: null, maxPos: null };
00209: 
00210:   const uniq = Array.from(new Set(parts)).sort((a, b) => a - b);
00211:   return { positions: uniq, maxPos: uniq[uniq.length - 1] };
00212: }

00231: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00232:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00233:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 6);
00234:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00235:   let idx = 0;
00236: 
00237:   async function worker() {
00238:     while (true) {
00239:       const current = idx;
00240:       idx += 1;
00241:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
00242:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00243:     }
00244:   }
00245: 
00246:   await Promise.all(
00247:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
00248:   );
00249: 
00250:   return results;
00251: }

00482: async function handleRange(req, res) {
00483:   try {
00484:     const db = getDb();
00485: 
00486:     const dateFrom = String(req.query.dateFrom || "").trim();
00487:     const dateTo = String(req.query.dateTo || "").trim();
00488:     const lottery = getLotteryFromQuery(req);
00489: 
00490:     if (!requireLotteryOr400(lottery, res)) return;
00491: 
00492:     if (!isISODate(dateFrom) || !isISODate(dateTo)) {
00493:       return res.status(400).json({
00494:         ok: false,
00495:         error: "Parâmetro inválido: dateFrom/dateTo (use YYYY-MM-DD)",
00496:       });
00497:     }
00498: 
00499:     if (dateFrom > dateTo) {
00500:       return res.status(400).json({
00501:         ok: false,
00502:         error: "Parâmetro inválido: dateFrom não pode ser maior que dateTo",
00503:       });
00504:     }
00505: 
00506:     const win = getWindowFromQuery(req);
00507:     if (win.error) return res.status(400).json({ ok: false, error: win.error });
00508: 
00509:     const includePrizes = parseIncludePrizes(req.query.includePrizes, false);
00510:     const positionsInfo = parsePositionsParam(req.query.positions);
00511: 
00512:     const snap = await db
00513:       .collection("draws")
00514:       .where("ymd", ">=", dateFrom)
00515:       .where("ymd", "<=", dateTo)
00516:       .orderBy("ymd", "asc")
00517:       .get();
00518: 
00519:     const rawDraws = snap.docs.map(normalizeDrawDoc);
00520:     const byLottery = applyLotteryFilter(rawDraws, lottery).sort(sortDrawsByDateThenHour);
00521:     const drawsWindow = applyHourWindow(byLottery, win.from || "", win.to || "");
00522:     const draws = await loadPrizesForDraws(db, drawsWindow, includePrizes, positionsInfo);
00523: 
00524:     const groupedIntegrity = {};
00525:     if (lottery === "PT_RIO") {
00526:       const rawByDay = rawDraws.reduce((acc, d) => {
00527:         const ymd = String(d.ymd || d.date || "").trim();
00528:         if (!ymd) return acc;
00529:         if (!acc[ymd]) acc[ymd] = [];
00530:         acc[ymd].push(d);
00531:         return acc;
00532:       }, {});
00533: 
00534:       const filteredByDay = draws.reduce((acc, d) => {
00535:         const ymd = String(d.ymd || d.date || "").trim();
00536:         if (!ymd) return acc;
00537:         if (!acc[ymd]) acc[ymd] = [];
00538:         acc[ymd].push(d);
00539:         return acc;
00540:       }, {});
00541: 
00542:       const allDays = Array.from(
00543:         new Set([
00544:           ...Object.keys(rawByDay),
00545:           ...Object.keys(filteredByDay),
00546:         ])
00547:       ).sort();
00548: 
00549:       for (const ymd of allDays) {
00550:         const dayRaw = rawByDay[ymd] || [];
00551:         const dayFiltered = filteredByDay[ymd] || [];
00552:         const hasFederal = hasFederalInDraws(dayRaw);
00553:         groupedIntegrity[ymd] = checkDrawIntegrity(dayFiltered, lottery, ymd, hasFederal);
00554:       }
00555:     }
00556: 
00557:     return res.json({
00558:       ok: true,
00559:       mode: "range",
00560:       integrityByDay: groupedIntegrity,
00561:       dateFrom,
00562:       dateTo,
00563:       lottery,
00564:       from: win.from || null,
00565:       to: win.to || null,
00566:       includePrizes,
00567:       count: draws.length,
00568:       draws,
00569:     });
00570:   } catch (e) {
00571:     return res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: e?.message || "erro" });
00572:   }
00573: }

00526: function buildCalendarStatus({ slotsSummary, blocked = false, blockedReason = "", isToday = false }) {
00527:   const expected = Number(slotsSummary?.expectedTotal || 0);
00528:   const found = Number(slotsSummary?.foundTotal || 0);
00529:   const missing = Number(slotsSummary?.missingTotal || 0);
00530: 
00531:   let status = "empty";
00532:   if (blocked) status = blockedReason === "future_date" ? "future" : "blocked";
00533:   else if (isToday && missing > 0) status = "pending";
00534:   else if (expected > 0 && missing === 0) status = "complete";
00535:   else if (found > 0 && missing > 0) status = "partial";
00536:   else if (expected > 0 && found === 0) status = "empty";
00537: 
00538:   return {
00539:     status,
00540:     expected,
00541:     found,
00542:     missing,
00543:     completionPct: Number(slotsSummary?.completionPct ?? 0),
00544:   };
00545: }

00547: function buildSlots(opts) {
00548:   const {
00549:     scheduleAll,
00550:     byHour,
00551:     baseSoft,
00552:     removedHardApplied,
00553:     removedSoftApplied,
00554:     expectedHard,
00555:     expectedSoft,
00556:     expectedHardPublished,
00557:     expectedSoftPublished,
00558:     capToday,
00559:     isToday,
00560:     nowMinBR,
00561:     slotGraceMin,
00562:   } = opts || {};
00563: 
00564:   return (Array.isArray(scheduleAll) ? scheduleAll : []).map((hh) => {
00565:     const draw = byHour?.get ? byHour.get(hh) || null : null;
00566: 
00567:     const isSoft = Array.isArray(baseSoft) && baseSoft.includes(hh);
00568:     const kind = isSoft ? "soft" : "hard";
00569: 
00570:     if (removedHardApplied?.has?.(hh) || removedSoftApplied?.has?.(hh)) {
00571:       return { hour: hh, kind, status: "gap", reason: "source_gap", draw: null };
00572:     }
00573: 
00574:     if (draw) return { hour: hh, kind, status: "valid", draw };
00575: 
00576:     if (
00577:       capToday &&
00578:       isToday &&
00579:       ((expectedHard && expectedHard.includes(hh)) || (expectedSoft && expectedSoft.includes(hh)))
00580:     ) {
00581:       const published = isSlotPublishedToday(hh, nowMinBR, slotGraceMin);
00582:       if (!published) {
00583:         return { hour: hh, kind, status: "future", reason: "not_yet_published", draw: null };
00584:       }
00585:     }
00586: 
00587:     if (expectedHardPublished && expectedHardPublished.includes(hh)) {
00588:       return { hour: hh, kind: "hard", status: "missing", draw: null };
00589:     }
00590:     if (expectedSoftPublished && expectedSoftPublished.includes(hh)) {
00591:       return { hour: hh, kind: "soft", status: "soft_missing", draw: null };
00592:     }
00593: 
00594:     return { hour: hh, kind, status: "gap", reason: "not_expected", draw: null };
00595:   });
00596: }

00124: function auditCountsFromDocs(rows) {
00125:   const setYmd = new Set();
00126:   const setYmdHour = new Set();
00127:   const mapKeyCount = new Map();

00129:

00138:   }
00139:

00141:     .filter(([, n]) => n > 1)
00142:     .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
00143: 
00144:   return {
00145:     docs_brutos: rows.length,
00146:     unique_ymd: setYmd.size,
00147:     unique_ymd_hour: setYmdHour.size,
00148:     invalid_ymd: invalidYmd,
00149:     keys_total: mapKeyCount.size,
00150:     keys_duplicadas: dupKeys.length,
00151:     top_duplicadas: dupKeys.slice(0, 15),

00155: async function fetchRowsForRange(db, { lotteryKey, fromYmd, toYmd, pageSize = 2000, maxPages = 80 } = {}) {
00156:   const lot = lotteryKey ? String(lotteryKey).trim().toUpperCase() : null;
00157: 
00158:   // 1) tentativa indexada (aceita range parcial)
00159:   try {
00160:     let q = db.collection("draws");
00161:     if (lot) q = q.where("lottery_key", "==", lot);
00162:     if (fromYmd) q = q.where("ymd", ">=", fromYmd);
00163:     if (toYmd) q = q.where("ymd", "<=", toYmd);
00164: 
00165:     const snap = await q.get();
00166:     const rows = snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...(d.data() || {}) }));
00167:     return { rows, source: "query: where(lottery_key)+where(ymd>=/<=)", usedFallback: false };
00168:   } catch (e) {
00169:     if (!isIndexError(e)) throw e;
00170:   }
00171: 
00172:   // 2) fallback sem índice: pagina por docId e filtra em memória
00173:   const DOC_ID = admin.firestore.FieldPath.documentId();
00174:   let q = db.collection("draws");
00175:   if (lot) q = q.where("lottery_key", "==", lot);
00176:   q = q.orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc");
00177: 
00178:   let last = null;
00179:   const out = [];
00180: 
00181:   for (let page = 1; page <= maxPages; page++) {
00182:     let qq = q.limit(pageSize);
00183:     if (last) qq = qq.startAfter(last);
00184: 
00185:     const snap = await qq.get();
00186:     if (snap.empty) break;
00187: 
00188:     for (const doc of snap.docs) {
00189:       const data = doc.data() || {};
00190:       const ymd = normalizeToYMD(data.ymd ?? data.date ?? data.draw_date ?? data.close_date ?? data.dt ?? data.data);
00191:       if (!ymd || !isISODateStrict(ymd)) continue;
00192:       if (fromYmd && ymd < fromYmd) continue;
00193:       if (toYmd && ymd > toYmd) continue;
00194:       out.push({ id: doc.id, ...data });
00195:     }
00196: 
00197:     last = snap.docs[snap.docs.length - 1];
00198:   }
00199: 
00200:   return { rows: out, source: "fallback: paginate by docId + filter(ymd)", usedFallback: true };
00201: }

00205:   if (i >= 0 && process.argv[i + 1] != null) return process.argv[i + 1];
00206:   return def;
00207: }

00022: function normalizeHHMM(value) {
00023:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00024:   if (/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(s)) return s;
00025: 
00026:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00027:   if (m1) return `${String(m1[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00028: 
00029:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00030:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00031: 
00032:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00033:   if (m3) return `${String(m3[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m3[2]).padStart(2, "0")}`;
00034: 
00035:   return "";
00036: }
00037:

00022: function normalizeHHMM(value) {
00023:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00024:   if (/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(s)) return s;
00025: 
00026:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00027:   if (m1) return `${String(m1[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00028: 
00029:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00030:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00031: 
00032:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00033:   if (m3) return `${String(m3[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m3[2]).padStart(2, "0")}`;
00034: 
00035:   return "";
00036: }
00037:

00710: async function verifySlotPersistedViaBackend({ date, slotHHMM }) {
00711:   try {
00712:     const base = PITACO_API_BASE.replace(/\/+$/, "");
00713:     const u = `${base}/api/pitaco/results?date=${encodeURIComponent(date)}&lottery=${encodeURIComponent(LOTTERY)}`;
00714: 
00715:     const res = await axios.get(u, {
00716:       timeout: 15000,
00717:       validateStatus: (s) => s >= 200 && s < 400,
00718:       headers: { "User-Agent": "palpitaco-autoImportToday" },
00719:     });
00720: 
00721:     const j = res && res.data ? res.data : null;
00722:     if (!j || typeof j !== "object") return { ok: false, reason: "BAD_JSON" };
00723: 
00724:     const draws = Array.isArray(j.draws) ? j.draws : [];
00725:     const foundInDraws = draws.some((d) => drawLooksLikeSlot(d, slotHHMM));
00726:     if (foundInDraws) return { ok: true, where: "draws", drawsCount: draws.length };
00727: 
00728:     const slots = Array.isArray(j.slots) ? j.slots : [];
00729:     const hh = hhFromSlotHHMM(slotHHMM);
00730: 
00731:     const foundInSlots = slots.some((s) => {
00732:       const v = (s && (s.hour || s.close_hour || s.closeHour || s.close || s.slot || s.time || s.close_hour_raw)) ?? "";
00733:       const t = String(v).trim();
00734:       return t.startsWith(hh);
00735:     });
00736: 
00737:     if (foundInSlots) return { ok: true, where: "slots", slotsCount: slots.length };
00738: 
00739:     return { ok: false, reason: "NOT_FOUND", drawsCount: draws.length, slotsCount: slots.length };
00740:   } catch (e) {
00741:     const code = e?.code || e?.cause?.code || "";
00742:     const msg = e?.message || e?.cause?.message || String(e);
00743:     const r = code ? `${code}:${msg}` : msg;
00744:     return { ok: false, reason: `EX:${r}` };
00745:   }

00748: async function guardPersistedOrCritical({ date, slotHHMM, calendar, closeHourTried, meta }) {
00749:   if (!VERIFY_PERSISTED) return { ok: true, skipped: true };
00750: 
00751:   if (meta && (meta.mode === "ALREADY_COMPLETE" || meta.mode === "NO_DRAW")) {
00752:     return { ok: true, skipped: true, reason: `SKIP_${meta.mode}` };
00753:   }
00754: 
00755:   if (meta && meta.mode === "CAPTURE_WRITE") {
00756:     const sc = Number.isFinite(Number(meta.savedCount)) ? Number(meta.savedCount) : 0;
00757:     const wc = Number.isFinite(Number(meta.writeCount)) ? Number(meta.writeCount) : 0;
00758:     if (sc > 0 || wc > 0) {
00759:       return { ok: true, verified: true, where: "import_return", skippedBackend: true };
00760:     }
00761:   }
00762: 
00763:   const v = await verifySlotPersistedViaBackend({ date, slotHHMM });
00764:   if (v.ok) return { ok: true, verified: true, where: v.where };
00765: 
00766:   const file = upsertMissingSlot({
00767:     date,
00768:     slotHour: slotHHMM,
00769:     calendar,
00770:     closeHourTried,
00771:     reason: v.reason || "NOT_PERSISTED",
00772:     meta: { verify: v, ...(meta || {}) },
00773:   });
00774: 
00775:   logLine(
00776:     `[BIRTH-GUARD] CRITICAL slot=${slotHHMM} date=${date} calendar=${calendar || "—"} closeTried=${closeHourTried || "—"} reason=${
00777:       v.reason || "NOT_PERSISTED"
00778:     } file=${path.basename(file)}`,
00779:     "ERROR"
00780:   );
00781: 
00782:   if (FAIL_ON_CRITICAL) process.exitCode = 2;
00783: 
00784:   return { ok: false, verified: false, reason: v.reason || "NOT_PERSISTED", file };
00785: }

00787: /**

00791: function syncStateFromBackendSnapshot({
00792:   state,
00793:   statusMap,
00794:   daySnapshot,
00795:   isoNow,
00796: }) {
00797:   const rawPresentHours = Array.isArray(daySnapshot?.presentHours)
00798:     ? daySnapshot.presentHours
00799:     : [];
00800: 
00801:   const presentHours = new Set(
00802:     rawPresentHours
00803:       .map((value) => {
00804:         const match = String(value ?? "").trim().match(/(\d{1,2})/);
00805:         if (!match) return "";
00806: 
00807:         const hour = Number(match[1]);
00808:         if (!Number.isFinite(hour) || hour < 0 || hour > 23) return "";
00809: 
00810:         return pad2(hour);
00811:       })
00812:       .filter(Boolean)
00813:   );
00814: 
00815:   if (!presentHours.size) return 0;
00816: 
00817:   let touched = 0;
00818: 
00819:   for (const sched of SCHEDULE) {
00820:     const slot = state?.[sched.hour];
00821:     if (!slot || slot.done || slot.na) continue;
00822: 
00823:     const calendar = statusMap.get(sched.hour) || "OFF";
00824:     if (calendar !== "HARD" && calendar !== "SOFT") continue;
00825: 
00826:     const hour = String(sched.hour || "").slice(0, 2);
00827:     if (!presentHours.has(hour)) continue;
00828: 
00829:     slot.done = true;
00830:     slot.na = false;
00831:     slot.naReason = null;
00832:     slot.lastTryISO = slot.lastTryISO || isoNow;
00833:     slot.lastResult = {
00834:       ...(slot.lastResult || {}),
00835:       ok: true,
00836:       reconciledFromBackend: true,
00837:       reason: "BACKEND_PRESENT_HOUR",
00838:       presentHour: hour,
00839:     };
00840:     slot.alertMissedWindow = false;
00841:     slot.alertCritical = false;
00842: 
00843:     touched += 1;
00844: 
00845:     logLine(
00846:       `[STATE-SYNC] backend confirmou slot=${sched.hour} presente -> DONE`,
00847:       "INFO"
00848:     );
00849:   }
00850: 
00851:   return touched;
00852: }

00861: function buildAuditReport({ date, nowMin, isoNow, dow, statusMap, state }) {
00862:   const todayBR = todayYMDInSaoPaulo();
00863:   const critical = [];
00864:   const warning = [];
00865:   const softLate = [];
00866: 
00867:   for (const sched of SCHEDULE) {
00868:     const slotState = state?.[sched.hour];
00869:     if (!slotState) continue;
00870: 
00871:     const st = statusMap.get(sched.hour) || "OFF";
00872:     const isHard = st === "HARD";
00873:     const isSoft = st === "SOFT";
00874:     const applies = isHard || isSoft;
00875:     if (!applies) continue;
00876: 
00877:     if (slotState.na) continue;
00878:     if (slotState.done) continue;
00879: 
00880:     const w = slotWindow(sched);
00881: 
00882:     if (nowMin < w.release) continue;
00883:     const since = nowMin - w.release;
00884: 
00885:     const item = {
00886:       slot: sched.hour,
00887:       calendar: st,
00888:       rule: "window",
00889:       releaseAt: w.releaseLabel,
00890:       windowEnd: w.endLabel,
00891:       sinceMinutes: since,
00892:       tries: Number(slotState.tries || 0),
00893:       lastTryISO: slotState.lastTryISO || null,
00894:       lastResult: slotState.lastResult || null,
00895:     };
00896: 
00897:     if (isSoft) {
00898:       if (since >= WARN_AFTER_MIN) softLate.push(item);
00899:       continue;
00900:     }
00901: 
00902:     if (since >= CRIT_AFTER_MIN) critical.push(item);
00903:     else if (since >= WARN_AFTER_MIN) warning.push(item);
00904:   }
00905: 
00906:   let status = "ok";
00907:   if (critical.length) status = "critical";
00908:   else if (warning.length) status = "warning";
00909:

00913:     date,
00914:     todayBR,
00915:     isoNow,
00916:     dow,

00918:     status,

00931: function emitHardAlertsIfNeeded({ date, nowMin, state, statusMap }) {
00932:   let touched = false;
00933: 
00934:   for (const sched of SCHEDULE) {
00935:     let slot = state?.[sched.hour];
00936: 
00937:     if (!slot) {
00938:       slot = { hour: sched.hour, done: false, na: false, tries: 0 };
00939:       state[sched.hour] = slot;
00940:     }
00941: 
00942:     if (slot.done || slot.na) continue;
00943: 
00944:     const st = statusMap.get(sched.hour) || "OFF";
00945:     if (st !== "HARD") continue;
00946: 
00947:     const w = slotWindow(sched);
00948:     if (nowMin < w.release) continue;
00949: 
00950:     const since = nowMin - w.release;
00951: 
00952:     if (nowMin > w.end && !slot.alertMissedWindow) {
00953:       slot.alertMissedWindow = true;
00954:       touched = true;
00955:       logLine(
00956:         `[ALERT] HARD slot perdeu janela: date=${date} slot=${sched.hour} releaseAt=${w.releaseLabel} windowEnd=${w.endLabel} tries=${slot.tries || 0}`,
00957:         "ERROR"
00958:       );
00959:     }
00960: 
00961:     if (since >= CRIT_AFTER_MIN && !slot.alertCritical) {
00962:       slot.alertCritical = true;
00963:       touched = true;
00964:       logLine(
00965:         `[ALERT] HARD slot CRITICAL: date=${date} slot=${sched.hour} since=${since}min (>=${CRIT_AFTER_MIN}) tries=${slot.tries || 0}`,
00966:         "ERROR"
00967:       );
00968:     }
00969:   }
00970:

00347: /**
00348:  * ✅ Normaliza close_hour para SLOT (campo de negócio)
00349:  * - Para PT_RIO: força minutos = 00 (09:09 -> 09:00)
00350:  * - Para outros: preserva raw
00351:  *
00352:  * Correção crítica:
00353:  * - A API do PT_RIO costuma devolver HH:09 como "marcação" e NÃO um minuto real.
00354:  * - Portanto, para PT_RIO, se raw terminar em ":09", tratamos como "sem minuto real"
00355:  *   e NÃO persistimos close_hour_raw (vira "").
00356:  *
00357:  * Retorna:
00358:  * - raw: HH:MM (normalizado) OU "" quando for "sintético" (PT_RIO HH:09)
00359:  * - slot: HH:MM (normalizado para o que o sistema deve usar em consultas/ID)
00360:  */
00361: function normalizeCloseHourForLottery(value, lotteryKey) {
00362:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00363:   const raw0 = normalizeHHMM(value);
00364:   if (!raw0 || !isHHMM(raw0)) return { raw: "", slot: "" };
00365: 
00366:   // ✅ FEDERAL: slot de negócio é sempre 20:00, mas preserva o raw
00367:   if (lk === "FEDERAL") {
00368:     return { raw: raw0, slot: "20:00" };
00369:   }
00370: 
00371:   if (lk === "PT_RIO") {
00372:     const hh = raw0.slice(0, 2);
00373:     const mm = raw0.slice(3, 5);
00374: 
00375:     // ✅ se vier HH:09, é marcação (não minuto real) -> não grava close_hour_raw
00376:     const raw = mm === "09" ? "" : raw0;
00377:     return { raw, slot: `${hh}:00` };
00378:   }
00379: 
00380:   return { raw: raw0, slot: raw0 };
00381: }

00713: /**
00714:  * ✅ Merge + dedup de draws vindos de múltiplos requests
00715:  * Dedup key: date + close_hour(SLOT) + lottery_id (se existir)
00716:  */
00717: function mergeAndDedupDraws(arrays, lotteryKey) {
00718:   const map = new Map();
00719: 
00720:   for (const a of arrays) {
00721:     const list = Array.isArray(a) ? a : [];
00722:     for (const d of list) {
00723:       const date = String(d?.date || "").trim();
00724:       const { slot } = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(d?.close_hour || "", lotteryKey);
00725: 
00726:       const lid =
00727:         pickLotteryId(d) ||
00728:         String(d?.lottery_name || d?.name || "").trim() ||
00729:         "NA";
00730:       const key = `${date}__${slot}__${lid}`;
00731: 
00732:       if (!map.has(key)) {
00733:         map.set(key, d);
00734:       } else {
00735:         // se duplicado, preferir o que tiver mais prizes preenchidos
00736:         const prev = map.get(key);
00737:         const prevCount = countPrizesInDraw(prev);
00738:         const curCount = countPrizesInDraw(d);
00739:         if (curCount > prevCount) map.set(key, d);
00740:       }
00741:     }
00742:   }
00743: 
00744:   return Array.from(map.values());
00745: }
00746: 
00747: function countPrizesInDraw(draw) {
00748:   let c = 0;
00749:   for (let i = 1; i <= 15; i++) {
00750:     const v = draw?.[`prize_${i}`];
00751:     if (v === null || v === undefined || String(v).trim() === "") continue;
00752:     c++;
00753:   }
00754:   return c;
00755: }

00757: function summarizeCloseHours(draws, lotteryKey) {
00758:   const set = new Set();
00759:   for (const d of draws) {
00760:     const { slot } = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(d?.close_hour || "", lotteryKey);
00761:     if (slot) set.add(slot);
00762:   }
00763:   return Array.from(set).sort();
00764: }

00766: /**
00767:  * ✅ Fetch robusto:
00768:  * - Por default faz 1 request por lotteryId e mescla (evita “cap”/consolidação do endpoint)
00769:  * - Se KING_FETCH_PER_LOTTERY=0 -> faz 1 request único (modo antigo)

00771: async function fetchKingResults({ date, lotteryKey }) {
00772:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00773:   const lotteries = LOTTERIES_BY_KEY[lk];
00774:   if (!lotteries?.length) {
00775:     if (lk === "FEDERAL") {
00776:       throw new Error(
00777:         `FEDERAL sem lotteryIds. Defina KING_LOTTERIES_FEDERAL="uuid1,uuid2,..." para habilitar fetch.`
00778:       );
00779:     }
00780:     throw new Error(`lotteryKey inválida: ${lk}`);
00781:   }
00782: 
00783:   if (!FETCH_PER_LOTTERY) {
00784:     const url = buildResultsUrl({ date, lotteryKey: lk });
00785:     return await axiosGetJson(url);
00786:   }
00787: 
00788:   // ✅ 1 request por lottery (sequencial: mais estável e respeita rate-limit)
00789:   const parts = [];
00790:   const errors = [];
00791: 
00792:   // helper local: extrai e normaliza closes vindos nesse UUID
00793:   const closeFromDraw = (d) =>
00794:     normalizeHHMM(d?.close_hour ?? d?.closeHour ?? d?.horario ?? d?.close ?? "");
00795: 
00796:   const summarizeCloseHoursPart = (list) => {
00797:     const set = new Set();
00798:     for (const d of Array.isArray(list) ? list : []) {
00799:       const c = closeFromDraw(d);
00800:       if (c) set.add(c);
00801:     }
00802:     return Array.from(set).sort();
00803:   };
00804: 
00805:   for (const lotteryId of lotteries) {
00806:     const url = buildResultsUrl({ date, lotteryKey: lk, lotteryId });
00807: 
00808:     try {
00809:       const data = await axiosGetJson(url);
00810: 
00811:       // ✅ carimba o UUID do request em cada draw (a API nem sempre retorna lottery_id)
00812:       if (data && Array.isArray(data.data)) {
00813:         data.data = data.data.map((d) => ({
00814:           ...d,
00815:           lottery_id: d?.lottery_id || lotteryId,
00816:           lotteryId: d?.lotteryId || lotteryId,
00817:         }));
00818:       }
00819:       const list = Array.isArray(data?.data) ? data.data : [];
00820:       parts.push(list);
00821: 
00822:       if (KING_FETCH_DEBUG) {
00823:         const closesPart = summarizeCloseHoursPart(list);
00824:         console.log(
00825:           `[FETCH:PART] ${lk} ${date} lotteryId=${lotteryId} draws=${list.length} close_hours=[${closesPart.join(
00826:             ", "
00827:           )}]`
00828:         );
00829:       }
00830:     } catch (e) {
00831:       const msg = e?.response?.status
00832:         ? `HTTP_${e.response.status}`
00833:         : e?.code || e?.message || "ERR";
00834: 
00835:       errors.push({ lotteryId, msg });
00836: 
00837:       console.warn(
00838:         `[FETCH:PART] ${lk} ${date} lotteryId=${lotteryId} ERROR=${msg} (seguindo...)`
00839:       );
00840: 
00841:       // segue para não travar o dia inteiro por 1 UUID
00842:       continue;
00843:     }
00844:   }
00845: 
00846:   const merged = mergeAndDedupDraws(parts, lk);
00847:   const closes = summarizeCloseHours(merged, lk);
00848:   const errInfo =
00849:     KING_FETCH_DEBUG && errors.length
00850:       ? ` errors=${errors.length} ids=[${errors.map((x) => x.lotteryId).join(",")}]`
00851:       : "";
00852: 
00853:   console.log(
00854:     `[FETCH] ${lk} ${date} per-lottery=${lotteries.length} -> merged_draws=${
00855:       merged.length
00856:     } close_hours=[${closes.join(", ")}]${errInfo}`
00857:   );
00858:   return { success: true, data: merged };
00859: }

00908: /**
00909:  * Prova forte de “já completo”:
00910:  * - draw existe
00911:  * - prizesCount > 0 (ou) existe ao menos 1 doc na subcoleção prizes
00912:  */
00913: async function checkAlreadyComplete(drawRef) {
00914:   try {
00915:     const dSnap = await drawRef.get();
00916:     if (!dSnap.exists) return false;
00917: 
00918:     const data = dSnap.data() || {};
00919:     if (Number(data.prizesCount) > 0) return true;
00920: 
00921:     // fallback: olha 1 doc de prizes
00922:     const pSnap = await drawRef.collection("prizes").limit(1).get();
00923:     return !pSnap.empty;
00924:   } catch {
00925:     return false;
00926:   }
00927: }

00929: /**
00930:  * ✅ Prova forte por SLOT (anti-índice composto)
00931:  * - Query filtra SOMENTE por date
00932:  * - close_hour + lottery_key/lotteryKey filtrados em memória
00933:  *
00934:  * ✅ FIX CRÍTICO:
00935:  * - Normaliza o close_hour armazenado (pode existir legado "09:09")
00936:  *   e compara por SLOT (HH:00), para não “perder” doc existente.
00937:  */
00938: async function checkSlotCompletion({ date, closeHour, lotteryKey }) {
00939:   try {
00940:     const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00941:     const targetSlot = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(closeHour || "", lk).slot;
00942:     if (!targetSlot || !isHHMM(targetSlot)) return { docs: 0, complete: 0 };
00943: 
00944:     // query mínima
00945:     const snap = await db.collection("draws").where("date", "==", date).get();
00946:     if (snap.empty) return { docs: 0, complete: 0 };
00947: 
00948:     const refs = [];
00949:     snap.forEach((doc) => {
00950:       const d = doc.data() || {};
00951: 
00952:       const lkSnake = String(d.lottery_key || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00953:       const lkCamel = String(d.lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00954: 
00955:       if (lkSnake !== lk && lkCamel !== lk) return;
00956: 
00957:       // ✅ compara por SLOT normalizado (pega legado "09:09" como "09:00")
00958:       const storedSlot = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(d.close_hour || "", lk).slot;
00959:       if (storedSlot !== targetSlot) return;
00960: 
00961:       refs.push(doc.ref);
00962:     });
00963: 
00964:     if (!refs.length) return { docs: 0, complete: 0 };
00965: 
00966:     let complete = 0;
00967:     for (const ref of refs) {
00968:       const ok = await checkAlreadyComplete(ref);
00969:       if (ok) complete += 1;
00970:     }
00971: 
00972:     return { docs: refs.length, complete };
00973:   } catch {
00974:     return { docs: 0, complete: 0 };
00975:   }
00976: }

00978: /**

00986: async function importFromPayload({
00987:   payload,
00988:   lotteryKey,
00989:   closeHour = null,
00990:   skipIfAlreadyComplete = false,
00991: } = {}) {
00992:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00993:   const uf = resolveUfFromLotteryKey(lk); // ✅ UF correta (ex.: RJ)
00994: 
00995:   let batch = db.batch();
00996:   let ops = 0;
00997: 
00998:   let totalDrawsFromApi = 0;
00999:   let totalDrawsMatchedClose = 0;
01000:   let totalDrawsValid = 0;
01001: 
01002:   let totalDrawsUpserted = 0;
01003:   let totalDrawsSaved = 0;
01004: 
01005:   let totalPrizesUpserted = 0;
01006:   let totalPrizesSaved = 0;
01007: 
01008:   let skippedInvalid = 0;
01009:   let skippedEmpty = 0;
01010:   let skippedCloseHour = 0;
01011:   let skippedAlreadyComplete = 0;
01012: 
01013:   // Provas úteis para o scheduler (quando closeHour é informado)
01014:   const proof = {
01015:     filterClose: null,
01016: 
01017:     apiHasPrizes: false,
01018:     apiReturnedTargetDraws: 0, // draws válidos do closeHour com prizes
01019:     targetDrawIds: [],
01020:     inferredDate: null, // date do slot (inferido a partir do payload)
01021: 
01022:     expectedTargets: 0, // = max(1, apiReturnedTargetDraws)
01023:     slotDocsFound: 0,
01024:     alreadyCompleteCount: 0,
01025:     alreadyCompleteAny: false,
01026:     alreadyCompleteAll: false,
01027: 
01028:     targetWriteCount: 0,
01029:     targetSavedCount: 0,
01030:   };
01031: 
01032:   // ✅ filtro deve ser SLOT também
01033:   const filterClose = closeHour
01034:     ? normalizeCloseHourForLottery(closeHour, lk).slot
01035:     : null;
01036:   if (filterClose && !isHHMM(filterClose)) {
01037:     throw new Error('Parâmetro "closeHour" inválido. Use HH:MM.');
01038:   }
01039:   proof.filterClose = filterClose;
01040: 
01041:   const apiArr = Array.isArray(payload?.data) ? payload.data : [];
01042: 
01043:   for (const draw of apiArr) {
01044:     totalDrawsFromApi++;
01045: 
01046:     const date = String(draw?.date || "").trim();
01047:     const { raw: closeRaw, slot: closeSlot } = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(
01048:       draw?.close_hour || "",
01049:       lk
01050:     );
01051: 
01052:     // filtro por horário (SLOT)
01053:     if (filterClose) {
01054:       if (closeSlot !== filterClose) {
01055:         skippedCloseHour++;
01056:         continue;
01057:       }
01058:     }
01059: 
01060:     totalDrawsMatchedClose++;
01061: 
01062:     // validações mínimas (slot precisa ser HH:MM)
01063:     if (!isISODate(date) || !isHHMM(closeSlot)) {
01064:       skippedInvalid++;
01065:       continue;
01066:     }
01067: 
01068:     // prizes existentes
01069:     const prizes = extractPrizes(draw);
01070: 
01071:     // Se não tem prize nenhum, NÃO grava
01072:     if (!prizes.length) {
01073:       skippedEmpty++;
01074:       continue;
01075:     }
01076: 
01077:     totalDrawsValid++;
01078: 
01079:     if (filterClose) {
01080:       proof.apiHasPrizes = true;
01081:       proof.apiReturnedTargetDraws += 1;
01082:       proof.inferredDate = proof.inferredDate || date;
01083:     }
01084: 
01085:     const { drawId, drawRef, lotteryName, lotteryIdFromDraw } = buildDrawRef({
01086:       draw,
01087:       lotteryKey: lk,
01088:     });
01089: 
01090:     if (filterClose) proof.targetDrawIds.push(drawId);
01091: 
01092:     // Em closeHour: checa “já completo” e, se configurado, pula escrita (por draw)
01093:     if (filterClose) {
01094:       const already = await checkAlreadyComplete(drawRef);
01095:       if (skipIfAlreadyComplete && already) {
01096:         skippedAlreadyComplete++;
01097:         continue;
01098:       }
01099:     }
01100: 
01101:     // métrica "novo" (opcional — custa reads)
01102:     let isNewDraw = false;
01103:     if (CHECK_EXISTENCE) {
01104:       try {
01105:         const snap = await drawRef.get();
01106:         isNewDraw = !snap.exists;
01107:       } catch {
01108:         isNewDraw = false;
01109:       }
01110:     }

01113: 
01114:     batch.set(
01115:       drawRef,
01116:       {
01117:         source: "kingapostas",
01118: 
01119:         uf: uf || null,
01120:         lottery_key: lk,
01121: 
01122:         lottery_name: lotteryName,
01123:         lottery_id: lotteryIdFromDraw || null,
01124:         drawId,
01125: 
01126:         date,
01127:         ymd,
01128: 
01129:         // ✅ campo de negócio (SLOT)
01130:         close_hour: closeSlot,
01131: 
01132:         // ✅ compat: campos usados no front (evita undefined)
01133:         hour: closeSlot ? String(closeSlot).slice(0, 2) : null,
01134:         close: closeSlot || null,
01135: 
01136:         // ✅ guarda o que veio da API SOMENTE quando fizer sentido
01137:         // (PT_RIO HH:09 vira "", então cai em null)
01138:         close_hour_raw: closeRaw || null,
01139:

01141:         importedAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
01142:       },
01143:       { merge: true }
01144:     );
01145:     ops++;
01146:     totalDrawsUpserted++;
01147:     if (isNewDraw) totalDrawsSaved++;
01148: 
01149:     if (filterClose) proof.targetWriteCount += 1;
01150: 
01151:     for (const p of prizes) {
01152:       const n = normalizePrize(p.value);
01153:       const prizeId = `p${String(p.position).padStart(2, "0")}`;
01154:       const prizeRef = drawRef.collection("prizes").doc(prizeId);
01155: 
01156:       let isNewPrize = false;
01157:       if (CHECK_EXISTENCE) {
01158:         try {
01159:           const psnap = await prizeRef.get();
01160:           isNewPrize = !psnap.exists;
01161:         } catch {
01162:           isNewPrize = false;
01163:         }
01164:       }
01165: 
01166:       batch.set(
01167:         prizeRef,
01168:         {
01169:           position: p.position,
01170:           ...n,
01171:         },
01172:         { merge: true }
01173:       );
01174:       ops++;
01175:       totalPrizesUpserted++;
01176:       if (isNewPrize) totalPrizesSaved++;
01177: 
01178:       if (filterClose) proof.targetWriteCount += 1;
01179: 
01180:       if (ops >= 420) {
01181:         await batch.commit();
01182:         batch = db.batch();
01183:         ops = 0;
01184:       }
01185:     }
01186:   }
01187: 
01188:   if (ops > 0) await batch.commit();
01189: 
01190:   // ✅ flags finais de complete (por SLOT via query anti-índice)
01191:   if (proof.filterClose) {
01192:     const slotDate = proof.inferredDate; // se API trouxe o slot, teremos date
01193:     proof.expectedTargets = Math.max(1, Number(proof.apiReturnedTargetDraws || 0));
01194: 
01195:     if (slotDate) {
01196:       const { docs, complete } = await checkSlotCompletion({
01197:         date: slotDate,
01198:         closeHour: proof.filterClose,
01199:         lotteryKey: lk,
01200:       });
01201: 
01202:       proof.slotDocsFound = docs;
01203:       proof.alreadyCompleteCount = complete;
01204:       proof.alreadyCompleteAny = complete > 0;
01205:       proof.alreadyCompleteAll = complete >= proof.expectedTargets;
01206:     } else {
01207:       proof.slotDocsFound = 0;
01208:       proof.alreadyCompleteCount = 0;
01209:       proof.alreadyCompleteAny = false;
01210:       proof.alreadyCompleteAll = false;
01211:     }
01212: 
01213:     // savedCount “forte” para o scheduler:
01214:     if (!proof.apiHasPrizes) {
01215:       proof.targetSavedCount = 0;
01216:     } else if (skipIfAlreadyComplete && proof.alreadyCompleteAll) {
01217:       proof.targetSavedCount = 0;
01218:     } else {

01261: async function cleanupLegacyDrawsForDate({ date, lotteryKey }) {
01262:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
01263:   if (!date || !isISODate(date) || !lk)
01264:     return { ok: false, deleted: 0, slots: 0, reason: "bad_args" };
01265: 
01266:   const snap = await db.collection("draws").where("date", "==", date).get();
01267:   const rows = snap.docs.map((doc) => ({ ref: doc.ref, id: doc.id, ...doc.data() }));
01268: 
01269:   const mine = rows.filter(
01270:     (r) => String(r.lottery_key || "").trim().toUpperCase() === lk
01271:   );
01272: 
01273:   const bySlot = new Map();
01274:   for (const r of mine) {
01275:     const slot = String(r.close_hour || "").trim();
01276:     if (!slot) continue;
01277:     if (!bySlot.has(slot)) bySlot.set(slot, []);
01278:     bySlot.get(slot).push(r);
01279:   }
01280: 
01281:   let deleted = 0;
01282:   let slots = 0;
01283:   let batch = db.batch();
01284:   let ops = 0;
01285: 
01286:   for (const [slot, arr] of bySlot.entries()) {
01287:     const hasUuid = arr.some((x) => x.lottery_id && String(x.lottery_id).includes("-"));
01288:     if (!hasUuid) continue;
01289: 
01290:     const leg = arr.filter((x) => !x.lottery_id);
01291:     if (!leg.length) continue;
01292: 
01293:     for (const d of leg) {
01294:       batch.delete(d.ref);
01295:       deleted += 1;
01296:       ops += 1;
01297:       if (ops >= 450) {
01298:         await batch.commit();
01299:         batch = db.batch();
01300:         ops = 0;
01301:       }
01302:     }
01303:     slots += 1;
01304:   }
01305: 
01306:   if (ops > 0) await batch.commit();
01307: 
01308:   return { ok: true, deleted, slots };
01309: }

01636:     );
01637:   }
01638: 
01639:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
01640:   if (!lk || !LOTTERIES_BY_KEY[lk]) {
01641:     throw new Error(
01642:       "Uso: node backend/scripts/importKingApostas.js YYYY-MM-DD [PT_RIO|FEDERAL] [HH:MM]"
01643:     );
01644:   }
01645:

01647:   const todayBR = todayYMDLocal();
01648:   if (!ALLOW_FUTURE_DATE && isFutureISODate(date)) {
01649:     console.error(
01650:       `[BLOCK] future_date: date=${date} todayBR=${todayBR} (defina ALLOW_FUTURE_DATE=1 para liberar)`
01651:     );
01652:     process.exit(2);
01653:   }
01654: 
01655:   const norm = normalizeRequestedCloseHour(closeHour, lk);
01656:   if (norm.note === "invalid") {
01657:     throw new Error(
01658:       "Uso: node backend/scripts/importKingApostas.js YYYY-MM-DD [PT_RIO|FEDERAL] [HH:MM]"
01659:     );
01660:   }
01661:   const normalizedClose = norm.slot || null;
01662: 
01663:   // ✅ LOG HONESTO (mostra o que foi pedido e o slot efetivo)
01664:   const closeInfo =
01665:     norm.requested && normalizedClose
01666:       ? norm.requested === normalizedClose
01667:         ? ` ${normalizedClose}`
01668:         : ` req=${norm.requested} -> slot=${normalizedClose}`
01669:       : normalizedClose
01670:       ? ` ${normalizedClose}`
01671:       : norm.requested
01672:       ? ` req=${norm.requested}`
01673:       : "";
01674:

01676:

01678: 
01679:   // ✅ NOVO (CLI também): se pediram closeHour e ele não existe no dia, avisa e sai 0
01680:   if (normalizedClose) {
01681:     const closes = summarizeCloseHours(
01682:       Array.isArray(payload?.data) ? payload.data : [],
01683:       lk
01684:     );
01685:     const hasTarget = closes.includes(normalizedClose);
01686:

01733:       } else {

00006: function normalizeHour(v) {
00007:   const m = String(v || "").match(/(\d{1,2})/);
00008:   if (!m) return "";
00009:   return String(Number(m[1])).padStart(2, "0") + ":00";

00025: function isValidYMD(ymd) {
00026:   const s = String(ymd || "").trim();
00027:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)) return false;
00028: 
00029:   const [Y, M, D] = s.split("-").map((x) => Number(x));
00030:   if (!Number.isFinite(Y) || !Number.isFinite(M) || !Number.isFinite(D)) return false;
00031:   if (M < 1 || M > 12 || D < 1 || D > 31) return false;
00032: 
00033:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D));
00034:   return (
00035:     dt.getUTCFullYear() === Y &&
00036:     dt.getUTCMonth() + 1 === M &&
00037:     dt.getUTCDate() === D
00038:   );
00039: }

00058: /**
00059:  * Normaliza hour vindo do plan:
00060:  * aceita "09", "9", "09:00", 9, etc -> "HH"
00061:  */
00062: function normalizeHH(raw) {
00063:   const s = safeStr(raw);
00064:   if (!s) return null;
00065:   const m = s.match(/(\d{1,2})/);
00066:   if (!m) return null;
00067:   const hh = Number(m[1]);
00068:   if (!Number.isFinite(hh) || hh < 0 || hh > 23) return null;
00069:   return pad2(hh);
00070: }
00071: 
00072: /**
00073:  * Gera candidatos de close_hour:
00074:  * - para cada baseMin (ex.: 0 e 9)
00075:  * - aplica deltas de 0..tol (ex.: tol=2 => 0, +1, +2, -1, -2)
00076:  * - mantém ordem: baseMin0 (0,+1,+2,-1,-2), depois baseMin9 (9,+1,+2,-1,-2)
00077:  */
00078: function closeCandidates(hh, baseMins = [9], tolMin = 2) {
00079:   const h = Number(hh);
00080:   const tol = Math.max(0, Number(tolMin) || 0);
00081:   const deltas = [0];
00082:   for (let i = 1; i <= tol; i++) deltas.push(+i);
00083:   for (let i = 1; i <= tol; i++) deltas.push(-i);
00084: 
00085:   const out = [];
00086:   for (const bm of baseMins) {
00087:     const base = Number(bm);
00088:     for (const d of deltas) {
00089:       const mm = base + d;
00090:       if (mm < 0 || mm > 59) continue;
00091:       out.push(`${pad2(h)}:${pad2(mm)}`);
00092:     }
00093:   }
00094:   return Array.from(new Set(out));
00095: }

00099:   return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : def;
00100: }

00130: function dedupeDrawsLogicalPreferBest(draws) {
00131:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00132:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
00133: 
00134:   const byKey = new Map();
00135:   const order = [];
00136: 
00137:   const score = (d) => {
00138:     const prizesLen = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes.length : 0;
00139:     const pc = Number.isFinite(Number(d?.prizesCount)) ? Number(d.prizesCount) : 0;
00140:     const ymd = normalizeToYMD(getDrawDateRaw(d));
00141:     const hhmm = normHHMM(getDrawHourRaw(d));
00142:     const hasLogical = !!(ymd && hhmm);
00143:     return prizesLen * 1000000 + pc * 1000 + (hasLogical ? 10 : 0);
00144:   };
00145: 
00146:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00147:     const d = arr[i] || {};
00148:     const ymd = normalizeToYMD(getDrawDateRaw(d)) || "";
00149:     const hhmm = normHHMM(getDrawHourRaw(d)) || "";
00150:     const lotteryCode = getDrawLotteryCodeRaw(d) || "";

00153:       (d?.drawId != null && String(d.drawId)) ||
00154:       (d?.id != null && String(d.id)) ||
00155:       "";
00156: 
00157:     const hasLogical = !!(ymd && hhmm);
00158: 
00159:     const key = hasLogical
00160:       ? lotteryCode
00161:         ? `${ymd}__${hhmm}__${lotteryCode}`
00162:         : `${ymd}__${hhmm}`
00163:       : `id__${id || `idx_${i}`}`;
00164: 
00165:     if (!byKey.has(key)) {
00166:       byKey.set(key, d);
00167:       order.push(key);
00168:       continue;
00169:     }
00170: 
00171:     const prev = byKey.get(key);
00172:     if (score(d) > score(prev)) {
00173:       byKey.set(key, d);
00174:     }
00175:   }
00176: 
00177:   return order.map((k) => byKey.get(k)).filter(Boolean);
00178: }

00048: function normalizePlan(v) {
00049:   const s = String(v || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00050:   if (s === PLAN_PREMIUM) return PLAN_PREMIUM;
00051:   if (s === PLAN_VIP) return PLAN_VIP;
00052:   return PLAN_FREE;

00056:   return String(v || "").trim();
00057: }

00059: function isFutureIso(iso, refIso) {
00060:   return !!safeISO(iso) && safeISO(refIso) < safeISO(iso);
00061: }
00062: 
00063: function isPlanCurrentlyActive({ plan, planEndAt, isLifetime, refIso }) {
00064:   const p = normalizePlan(plan);
00065: 
00066:   if (p === PLAN_FREE) return true;
00067:   if (isLifetime === true) return true;
00068:   if (!safeISO(planEndAt)) return false;
00069: 
00070:   return isFutureIso(planEndAt, refIso);

00320: export function splitRangeIntoChunks(fromYmd, toYmd, chunkDays = DEFAULT_CHUNK_DAYS) {
00321:   const out = [];
00322:   if (!isYMD(fromYmd) || !isYMD(toYmd)) return out;
00323:   if (fromYmd > toYmd) return out;
00324: 
00325:   let curFrom = fromYmd;
00326:   while (curFrom <= toYmd) {
00327:     const curTo = addDaysUTC(curFrom, Number(chunkDays || DEFAULT_CHUNK_DAYS) - 1);
00328:     const boundedTo = curTo > toYmd ? toYmd : curTo;
00329:     out.push({ from: curFrom, to: boundedTo });
00330:     const next = addDaysUTC(boundedTo, 1);
00331:     if (next <= curFrom) break;
00332:     curFrom = next;
00333:   }
00334:   return out;
00335: }

00411: export function digitFromKey(key) {
00412:   const s = String(key || "");
00413:   let h = 0;
00414:   for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i += 1) h = (h * 31 + s.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
00415:   return String(h % 10);
00416: }

00051: function pad2(n) {
00052:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");

00054: function isYMD(s) {
00055:   return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(s || "").trim());
00056: }
00057: function ymdToBR(ymd) {
00058:   const m = String(ymd || "").trim().match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
00059:   if (!m) return "";
00060:   return `${m[3]}/${m[2]}/${m[1]}`;
00061: }
00062: function ymdToUTCDate(ymd) {
00063:   const m = String(ymd || "").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
00064:   if (!m) return null;
00065:   return new Date(Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3])));
00066: }

00322: function splitRangeIntoChunks(fromYmd, toYmd, chunkDays = CHUNK_DAYS) {
00323:   const out = [];
00324:   if (!isYMD(fromYmd) || !isYMD(toYmd)) return out;
00325:   if (fromYmd > toYmd) return out;
00326: 
00327:   let curFrom = fromYmd;
00328:   while (curFrom <= toYmd) {
00329:     const curTo = addDaysUTC(curFrom, chunkDays - 1);
00330:     const boundedTo = curTo > toYmd ? toYmd : curTo;
00331:     out.push({ from: curFrom, to: boundedTo });
00332:     const next = addDaysUTC(boundedTo, 1);
00333:     if (next <= curFrom) break;
00334:     curFrom = next;
00335:   }
00336:   return out;
00337: }

00339: function normalizeDrawsResult(maybe) {
00340:   if (Array.isArray(maybe)) return maybe;
00341:   if (Array.isArray(maybe?.draws)) return maybe.draws;
00342:   if (Array.isArray(maybe?.drawsRaw)) return maybe.drawsRaw;
00343:   if (Array.isArray(maybe?.data)) return maybe.data;
00344:   if (Array.isArray(maybe?.results)) return maybe.results;
00345:   return [];
00346: }

00413: function digitFromKey(key) {
00414:   const s = String(key || "");
00415:   let h = 0;
00416:   for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i += 1) h = (h * 31 + s.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
00417:   return String(h % 10);
00418: }

00423: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00424:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00425:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 3);
00426:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00427:   let idx = 0;
00428: 
00429:   async function worker() {
00430:     while (idx < arr.length) {
00431:       const current = idx++;
00432:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00433:     }
00434:   }

00458: }

00469:   return `https://app.kingapostas.com/bet/guess?pp=${payload}`;
00470: }

00151: /** ✅ Normaliza close_hour para HH:MM */
00152: function normHHMM(value) {
00153:   const s0 = String(value || "").trim();
00154:   if (!s0) return null;
00155: 
00156:   const s = s0.toLowerCase();
00157: 
00158:   // "09:00h" / "09:00"
00159:   const mISO = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?\s*h?$/i);
00160:   if (mISO) {
00161:     const hh = String(mISO[1]).padStart(2, "0");
00162:     const mm = String(mISO[2]).padStart(2, "0");
00163:     return `${hh}:${mm}`;
00164:   }
00165: 
00166:   // "09h00" / "9h00" / "09h00m"
00167:   const mhm = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})\s*h\s*(\d{1,2})?\s*(m|min)?\s*s?$/i);
00168:   if (mhm) {
00169:     const hh = String(mhm[1]).padStart(2, "0");
00170:     const mm = String(mhm[2] ?? "0").padStart(2, "0");
00171:     return `${hh}:${mm}`;
00172:   }
00173: 
00174:   // "9h" / "09h" / "09hs"
00175:   const mh = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})\s*h\s*s?$/i);
00176:   if (mh) return `${String(mh[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00177: 
00178:   // "9" / "09"
00179:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00180:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00181: 
00182:   return null;
00183: }

00538: function yearRangeToDates(minY, maxY, floorISO, ceilISO) {
00539:   const y1 = Number(minY);
00540:   const y2 = Number(maxY);
00541:   if (!Number.isFinite(y1) || !Number.isFinite(y2)) return null;
00542:

00544:   const b = Math.max(y1, y2);

00547:   let to = `${b}-12-31`;
00548: 
00549:   if (isISODate(floorISO) && from < floorISO) from = floorISO;
00550:   if (isISODate(ceilISO) && to > ceilISO) to = ceilISO;
00551:

00553:   return { from, to };
00554: }

00608: function dedupeDrawsForKpi(list, ufKey) {
00609:   const arr = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
00610:   if (!arr.length) return [];
00611:   const seen = new Set();
00612:   const out = [];
00613: 
00614:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00615:     const d = arr[i];
00616:     const k = getDrawUniqKeyForKpi(d, ufKey, i);
00617:     if (!k) continue;
00618:     if (seen.has(k)) continue;
00619:     seen.add(k);
00620:     out.push(d);
00621:   }
00622: 
00623:   return out;
00624: }

00626: function buildYearsAvailable(minISO, maxISO) {
00627:   if (!isISODate(minISO) || !isISODate(maxISO)) return [];
00628:   const y1 = Number(String(minISO).slice(0, 4));
00629:   const y2 = Number(String(maxISO).slice(0, 4));
00630:   if (!Number.isFinite(y1) || !Number.isFinite(y2)) return [];
00631:   const a = Math.min(y1, y2);
00632:   const b = Math.max(y1, y2);
00633:   const out = [];
00634:   for (let y = a; y <= b; y++) out.push(y);
00635:   return out;
00636: }

00106: function hourToMinutes(hhmm) {
00107:   const s = normalizeHourLike(hhmm);
00108:   const m = String(s).match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
00109:   if (!m) return null;
00110:   const hh = Number(m[1]);
00111:   const mm = Number(m[2]);
00112:   if (!Number.isFinite(hh) || !Number.isFinite(mm)) return null;
00113:   return hh * 60 + mm;
00114: }

00163: // escolhe "mais recente" entre (ymd + closeHour)
00164: function isMoreRecent(a, b) {
00165:   const ay = String(a?.lastYmd || "");
00166:   const by = String(b?.lastYmd || "");
00167:   if (ay && by && ay !== by) return ay > by;
00168: 
00169:   const am = hourToMinutes(a?.lastCloseHour || "");
00170:   const bm = hourToMinutes(b?.lastCloseHour || "");
00171:   if (am != null && bm != null && am !== bm) return am > bm;
00172: 
00173:   if (ay && !by) return true;
00174:   if (!ay && by) return false;
00175: 
00176:   return false;
00177: }

00179: // merge de múltiplas consultas (ex: 1º ao 5º) => pega a última aparição mais recente por grupo
00180: function mergeLateLists(lists, baseYmd) {
00181:   const byGrupo = new Map();
00182: 
00183:   for (const list of lists) {
00184:     const arr = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
00185:     for (const r of arr) {
00186:       const g = Number(r?.grupo);
00187:       if (!isValidGrupo(g)) continue;
00188: 
00189:       const candidate = {
00190:         grupo: g,
00191:         lastYmd: r?.lastYmd || null,
00192:         // ✅ normaliza aqui (evita “09h/09HS/9”)
00193:         lastCloseHour: r?.lastCloseHour ? normalizeHourLike(r.lastCloseHour) : "",
00194:       };
00195: 
00196:       if (!byGrupo.has(g)) {
00197:         byGrupo.set(g, candidate);
00198:         continue;
00199:       }
00200: 
00201:       const prev = byGrupo.get(g);
00202:       if (isMoreRecent(candidate, prev)) byGrupo.set(g, candidate);
00203:     }
00204:   }
00205: 
00206:   const out = [];
00207:   for (let g = 1; g <= 25; g += 1) {
00208:     const rec = byGrupo.get(g) || { grupo: g, lastYmd: null, lastCloseHour: "" };
00209:     const lastYmd = rec?.lastYmd || null;
00210:     const lastCloseHour = rec?.lastCloseHour ? normalizeHourLike(rec.lastCloseHour) : "";
00211:     const daysLate = lastYmd ? diffDaysUTC(lastYmd, baseYmd) : null;
00212: 
00213:     out.push({
00214:       grupo: g,
00215:       grupo2: toGrupo2(g),
00216:       lastYmd,
00217:       lastCloseHour,
00218:       daysLate,
00219:     });
00220:   }
00221: 
00222:   // ordenação: atraso desc, depois hora asc, depois grupo asc
00223:   out.sort((a, b) => {
00224:     const aa = a.daysLate == null ? 999999 : a.daysLate;
00225:     const bb = b.daysLate == null ? 999999 : b.daysLate;
00226:     if (bb !== aa) return bb - aa;
00227: 
00228:     const ma = hourToMinutes(a.lastCloseHour);
00229:     const mb = hourToMinutes(b.lastCloseHour);
00230:     if (ma != null && mb != null && ma !== mb) return ma - mb;
00231:     if (ma == null && mb != null) return 1;
00232:     if (ma != null && mb == null) return -1;
00233: 
00234:     return a.grupo - b.grupo;
00235:   });
00236: 
00237:   return out.map((r, idx) => ({ ...r, pos: idx + 1 }));
00238: }

00007: import { isYMD, toHourBucket, hourToInt } from "./top3.formatters";
00008: 
00009: /*
00010: TOP3+ — Cadeia de Bichos
00011: Modelo de transição de grupos
00012: 
00013: - Entende targetYmd / targetHourBucket
00014: - Encontra o draw imediatamente anterior ao alvo
00015: - Separa transições por faixa de horário
00016: - Evita ordenar sorteio sem hora como 00h
00017: - Evita vazamento usando apenas histórico anterior ao alvo no modo target_aware
00018: */
00019: 
00020: function safeInt(v, fallback = 0) {
00021:   const n = Number(v);
00022:   return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
00023: }
00024: 
00025: function drawSortTs(draw) {
00026:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00027:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00028: 
00029:   if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00030: 
00031:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00032:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00033: 
00034:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
00035:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00036: 
00037:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
00038: }
00039: 
00040: function slotTs(ymd, hourBucket) {
00041:   const safeYmd = String(ymd || "").trim();
00042:   const h = toHourBucket(hourBucket);
00043: 
00044:   if (!isYMD(safeYmd) || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00045: 
00046:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00047:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00048: 
00049:   const [Y, M, D] = safeYmd.split("-").map(Number);
00050:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00051: 
00052:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
00053: }
00054: 
00055: function dedupeAndSortDraws(draws) {
00056:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00057:   const map = new Map();
00058: 
00059:   for (const d of list) {
00060:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
00061:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
00062:     const ts = drawSortTs(d);
00063: 
00064:     if (!Number.isFinite(ts)) continue;
00065: 
00066:     const key =
00067:       String(d?.id || d?.drawId || "").trim() ||
00068:       (isYMD(y) && h ? `${y}|${h}` : "");
00069: 
00070:     if (!key) continue;
00071: 
00072:     const prev = map.get(key);
00073: 
00074:     if (!prev || ts < drawSortTs(prev)) {
00075:       map.set(key, d);
00076:     }
00077:   }
00078: 
00079:   return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => drawSortTs(a) - drawSortTs(b));
00080: }
00081: 
00082: function makeEdgeKey(fromHour, toHour) {
00083:   const from = toHourBucket(fromHour);
00084:   const to = toHourBucket(toHour);
00085: 
00086:   if (!from || !to) return "";
00087: 
00088:   return `${from}->${to}`;
00089: }
00090: 
00091: function getNestedMap(map, key) {
00092:   if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, new Map());
00093:   return map.get(key);
00094: }
00095: 
00096: function getHistoryBeforeTarget(draws, targetYmd, targetHourBucket) {
00097:   const list = dedupeAndSortDraws(draws);
00098:   const target = slotTs(targetYmd, targetHourBucket);
00099: 
00100:   if (!list.length || !Number.isFinite(target)) return [];
00101: 
00102:   return list.filter((d) => {
00103:     const ts = drawSortTs(d);
00104:     return Number.isFinite(ts) && ts < target;
00105:   });
00106: }
00107: 
00108: export function computeChainTransitions(draws) {
00109:   const list = dedupeAndSortDraws(draws);
00110:   const transitionsAny = new Map();
00111:   const transitionsByEdge = new Map();
00112: 
00113:   for (let i = 0; i < list.length - 1; i += 1) {
00114:     const fromDraw = list[i];
00115:     const toDraw = list[i + 1];
00116: 
00117:     const fromGrupo = Number(pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(fromDraw));
00118:     const toGrupo = Number(pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(toDraw));
00119:     const fromHour = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(fromDraw));
00120:     const toHour = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(toDraw));
00121: 
00122:     if (!Number.isFinite(fromGrupo) || !Number.isFinite(toGrupo)) continue;
00123:     if (fromGrupo < 1 || fromGrupo > 25) continue;
00124:     if (toGrupo < 1 || toGrupo > 25) continue;
00125:     if (!fromHour || !toHour) continue;
00126: 
00127:     const anyRow = getNestedMap(transitionsAny, fromGrupo);
00128:     anyRow.set(toGrupo, safeInt(anyRow.get(toGrupo), 0) + 1);
00129: 
00130:     const edgeKey = makeEdgeKey(fromHour, toHour);
00131:     if (!edgeKey) continue;
00132: 
00133:     const edgeMap = getNestedMap(transitionsByEdge, edgeKey);
00134:     const edgeRow = getNestedMap(edgeMap, fromGrupo);
00135:     edgeRow.set(toGrupo, safeInt(edgeRow.get(toGrupo), 0) + 1);
00136:   }
00137: 
00138:   return { transitionsAny, transitionsByEdge };
00139: }
00140: 
00141: function findPreviousDrawForTarget(draws, targetYmd, targetHourBucket) {
00142:   const list = dedupeAndSortDraws(draws);
00143:   if (!list.length) return null;
00144: 
00145:   const target = slotTs(targetYmd, targetHourBucket);
00146:   if (!Number.isFinite(target)) return null;
00147: 
00148:   let prev = null;
00149: 
00150:   for (const d of list) {
00151:     const ts = drawSortTs(d);
00152:     if (!Number.isFinite(ts)) continue;
00153: 
00154:     if (ts < target) {
00155:       prev = d;
00156:     } else {
00157:       break;
00158:     }
00159:   }
00160: 
00161:   return prev;
00162: }
00163: 
00164: function rankTransitionMap(rowMap, basedOnGrupo, topN) {
00165:   if (!rowMap || !rowMap.size) return [];
00166: 
00167:   const total = Array.from(rowMap.values()).reduce(
00168:     (acc, n) => acc + safeInt(n, 0),
00169:     0
00170:   );
00171: 
00172:   if (total <= 0) return [];
00173: 
00174:   return Array.from(rowMap.entries())
00175:     .sort((a, b) => {
00176:       if (Number(b[1]) !== Number(a[1])) return Number(b[1]) - Number(a[1]);
00177:       return Number(a[0]) - Number(b[0]);
00178:     })
00179:     .slice(0, Math.max(1, safeInt(topN, 3)))
00180:     .map(([grupo, freq], i) => {
00181:       const prob = Number(freq) / total;
00182: 
00183:       return {
00184:         rank: i + 1,
00185:         grupo: Number(grupo),
00186:         freq: Number(freq),
00187:         prob,
00188:         probPct: Number((prob * 100).toFixed(2)),
00189:         basedOnGrupo: Number(basedOnGrupo),
00190:         totalTransitionsFromGrupo: total,
00191:       };
00192:     });
00193: }
00194: 
00195: export function predictNextGrupoFromChain(arg1, arg2 = 3) {
00196:   if (Array.isArray(arg1)) {
00197:     const draws = arg1;
00198:     const topN = arg2;
00199: 
00200:     const list = dedupeAndSortDraws(draws);
00201:     if (!list.length) return [];
00202: 
00203:     const { transitionsAny } = computeChainTransitions(list);
00204:     const lastDraw = list[list.length - 1];
00205:     const lastGrupo = Number(pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(lastDraw));
00206: 
00207:     if (!Number.isFinite(lastGrupo) || lastGrupo < 1 || lastGrupo > 25) {
00208:       return [];
00209:     }
00210: 
00211:     const rowMap = transitionsAny.get(lastGrupo);
00212:     const ranked = rankTransitionMap(rowMap, lastGrupo, topN);
00213: 
00214:     return ranked.map((x) => ({
00215:       ...x,
00216:       mode: "legacy_any",
00217:       basedOnHour: toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(lastDraw)),
00218:       basedOnYmd: pickDrawYMD(lastDraw),
00219:       targetHour: "",
00220:       targetYmd: "",
00221:       transitionType: "ANY",
00222:       transitionEdge: "",
00223:     }));
00224:   }
00225: 
00226:   const { draws, targetYmd, targetHourBucket, topN = 3 } = arg1 || {};
00227: 
00228:   const targetHour = toHourBucket(targetHourBucket);
00229:   const safeTargetYmd = String(targetYmd || "").trim();
00230: 
00231:   if (!isYMD(safeTargetYmd) || !targetHour) return [];
00232: 
00233:   const historyBeforeTarget = getHistoryBeforeTarget(
00234:     draws,
00235:     safeTargetYmd,
00236:     targetHour
00237:   );
00238: 
00239:   if (!historyBeforeTarget.length) return [];
00240: 
00241:   const prevDraw = historyBeforeTarget[historyBeforeTarget.length - 1];
00242:   if (!prevDraw) return [];
00243: 
00244:   const prevGrupo = Number(pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(prevDraw));
00245:   const prevHour = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(prevDraw));
00246:   const prevYmd = pickDrawYMD(prevDraw);
00247: 
00248:   if (
00249:     !Number.isFinite(prevGrupo) ||
00250:     prevGrupo < 1 ||
00251:     prevGrupo > 25 ||
00252:     !prevHour ||
00253:     !isYMD(prevYmd)
00254:   ) {
00255:     return [];
00256:   }
00257: 
00258:   const { transitionsAny, transitionsByEdge } =
00259:     computeChainTransitions(historyBeforeTarget);
00260: 
00261:   const edgeKey = makeEdgeKey(prevHour, targetHour);
00262:   const edgeMap = edgeKey ? transitionsByEdge.get(edgeKey) || null : null;
00263:   const edgeRow = edgeMap ? edgeMap.get(prevGrupo) : null;
00264: 
00265:   let ranked = rankTransitionMap(edgeRow, prevGrupo, topN);

01565: function countLeadingStateMatches(currentState, histState) {
01566:   const a = Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [];
01567:   const b = Array.isArray(histState) ? histState : [];
01568:   const len = Math.min(a.length, b.length);
01569: 
01570:   let matched = 0;
01571:   for (let i = 0; i < len; i += 1) {
01572:     if (Number(a[i]) !== Number(b[i])) break;
01573:     matched += 1;
01574:   }
01575:   return matched;
01576: }

03392: function buildHistoricalSceneRanking(draws, currentScene, limit = 100) {
03393:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
03394:   if (!currentScene) return [];
03395: 
03396:   const ordered = list
03397:     .map((draw) => ({
03398:       draw,
03399:       scene: buildSceneFromDraw(draw),
03400:     }))
03401:     .filter((x) => x.scene)
03402:     .sort((a, b) => {
03403:       const ta = ymdHourToTs(a.scene?.ymd, a.scene?.hour);
03404:       const tb = ymdHourToTs(b.scene?.ymd, b.scene?.hour);
03405:       return Number(ta || 0) - Number(tb || 0);
03406:     });
03407: 
03408:   return ordered
03409:     .map((item, idx) => {
03410:       const next = ordered[idx + 1] || null;
03411:       const score = compareScenes(currentScene, item.scene);
03412: 
03413:       return {
03414:         draw: item.draw,
03415:         scene: item.scene,
03416:         nextDraw: next?.draw || null,
03417:         nextScene: next?.scene || null,
03418:         score,
03419:       };
03420:     })
03421:     .filter((x) => x.scene && x.nextDraw && Number(x.score) > 0)
03422:     .sort((a, b) => {
03423:       if (Number(b.score) !== Number(a.score)) {
03424:         return Number(b.score) - Number(a.score);
03425:       }
03426: 
03427:       const ta = ymdHourToTs(a.scene?.ymd, a.scene?.hour);
03428:       const tb = ymdHourToTs(b.scene?.ymd, b.scene?.hour);
03429:       return Number(tb || 0) - Number(ta || 0);
03430:     })
03431:     .slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(limit || 100)));

00670: function probFromFreq(freq, samples, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
00671:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
00672:   const denom = Math.max(1, Number(samples || 0) * 5);
00673:   const out = new Map();
00674: 
00675:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
00676:     const n = Number(freq.get(g) || 0);
00677:     out.set(g, n / denom);
00678:   }
00679: 
00680:   return out;
00681: }

00683: function computeStructuralBaseDistribution(
00684:   draws,
00685:   lotteryKey,
00686:   targetHour,
00687:   targetDow,
00688:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
00689: ) {
00690:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00691:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
00692:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
00693:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
00694: 
00695:   const freq = new Map();
00696:   let totalSamples = 0;
00697: 
00698:   for (const d of list) {
00699:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
00700:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
00701:     if (!h || !y) continue;
00702: 
00703:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
00704:       if (!isFederalDrawDay(y)) continue;
00705:       if (Number(getDowKey(y)) !== Number(targetDow)) continue;
00706:     } else {
00707:       if (h !== target) continue;
00708:     }
00709: 
00710:     const items = getAllTop5Groups(d);
00711:     if (!items.length) continue;
00712: 
00713:     totalSamples += 1;
00714: 
00715:     for (const it of items) {
00716:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
00717:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
00718:       freq.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) + 1);
00719:     }
00720:   }
00721: 
00722:   const out = new Map();
00723:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples * 5);
00724: 
00725:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
00726:     const n = Number(freq.get(g) || 0);
00727:     out.set(g, n / denom);
00728:   }
00729: 
00730:   return { scoreProb: out, totalSamples };
00731: }

00737: function sortDrawsAsc(draws) {
00738:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00739:   return [...list].sort((a, b) => {
00740:     const ya = pickDrawYMD(a);

00743:     const hb = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(b));
00744:     const tsa = ymdHourToTs(ya, ha);

00746:     return tsa - tsb;
00747:   });

04192:     });

01446:   draws,

01448:   targetHour,

01451: ) {

01459: 
01460:   for (const d of list) {

01464:

01468:     } else {
01469:       if (h !== target) continue;
01470:     }
01471:

01565: function countLeadingStateMatches(currentState, histState) {
01566:   const a = Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [];
01567:   const b = Array.isArray(histState) ? histState : [];
01568:   const len = Math.min(a.length, b.length);
01569: 
01570:   let matched = 0;
01571:   for (let i = 0; i < len; i += 1) {
01572:     if (Number(a[i]) !== Number(b[i])) break;
01573:     matched += 1;
01574:   }
01575:   return matched;
01576: }

03392: function buildHistoricalSceneRanking(draws, currentScene, limit = 100) {
03393:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
03394:   if (!currentScene) return [];
03395: 
03396:   const ordered = list
03397:     .map((draw) => ({
03398:       draw,
03399:       scene: buildSceneFromDraw(draw),
03400:     }))
03401:     .filter((x) => x.scene)
03402:     .sort((a, b) => {
03403:       const ta = ymdHourToTs(a.scene?.ymd, a.scene?.hour);
03404:       const tb = ymdHourToTs(b.scene?.ymd, b.scene?.hour);
03405:       return Number(ta || 0) - Number(tb || 0);
03406:     });
03407: 
03408:   return ordered
03409:     .map((item, idx) => {
03410:       const next = ordered[idx + 1] || null;
03411:       const score = compareScenes(currentScene, item.scene);
03412: 
03413:       return {
03414:         draw: item.draw,
03415:         scene: item.scene,
03416:         nextDraw: next?.draw || null,
03417:         nextScene: next?.scene || null,
03418:         score,
03419:       };
03420:     })
03421:     .filter((x) => x.scene && x.nextDraw && Number(x.score) > 0)
03422:     .sort((a, b) => {
03423:       if (Number(b.score) !== Number(a.score)) {
03424:         return Number(b.score) - Number(a.score);
03425:       }

00043: function slugifyLabel(label) {
00044:   const l = safeStr(label);
00045:   if (!l) return "";
00046: 
00047:   return l
00048:     .normalize("NFD")
00049:     .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
00050:     .toLowerCase()
00051:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_")
00052:     .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "");
00053: }
00054: 
00055: function stripQuery(url) {
00056:   const s = safeStr(url);
00057:   if (!s) return "";
00058: 
00059:   const q = s.indexOf("?");
00060:   const h = s.indexOf("#");
00061: 
00062:   const cut =
00063:     q >= 0 && h >= 0
00064:       ? Math.min(q, h)
00065:       : q >= 0
00066:         ? q
00067:         : h >= 0
00068:           ? h
00069:           : -1;
00070: 
00071:   return cut >= 0 ? s.slice(0, cut) : s;
00072: }
00073: 
00074: function addCacheBust(url, token = "v=1") {
00075:   const s = safeStr(url);
00076:   if (!s) return "";
00077: 
00078:   return s.includes("?") ? `${s}&${token}` : `${s}?${token}`;
00079: }

00082: function normalizeHourLike(value) {
00083:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00084:   if (!s) return null;
00085: 
00086:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00087:   if (m1) return `${String(m1[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00088: 
00089:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00090:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00091: 
00092:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00093:   if (m3) {
00094:     const hh = String(m3[1]).padStart(2, "0");
00095:     const mm = String(m3[2]).padStart(2, "0");
00096:     return `${hh}:${mm}`;
00097:   }
00098: 
00099:   return s;
00100: }
