00186: function dedupeDraws(drawsRaw) {
00187:   const arr = Array.isArray(drawsRaw) ? drawsRaw : [];
00188:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
00189: 
00190:   const seen = new Set();
00191:   const out = [];
00192: 
00193:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00194:     const d = arr[i];
00195: 
00196:     const ymd = normalizeToYMD(extractRawDateFromDraw(d)) || "";
00197:     const hh = normalizeHourLike(extractRawCloseHourFromDraw(d)) || "";
00198: 
00199:     const { uf, lottery } = extractDrawScope(d);
00200: 
00201:     const idLike =
00202:       (d?.drawId != null && String(d.drawId)) ||
00203:       (d?.id != null && String(d.id)) ||
00204:       "";
00205: 
00206:     let key = idLike;
00207: 
00208:     if (!key) {
00209:       // chave composta (mais segura do que só ymd+hora)
00210:       const scope = `${uf || ""}__${lottery || ""}`.trim();
00211:       const core = `${ymd}__${hh}`.trim();
00212:       key = `${scope}__${core}`.replace(/^__+|__+$/g, "");
00213:     }
00214: 
00215:     // Se ainda assim está “vazia” (sem info), não deduplica para evitar apagar tudo
00216:     if (!key || key === "__" || key === "____") {
00217:       out.push(d);
00218:       continue;
00219:     }
00220: 
00221:     if (seen.has(key)) continue;
00222:     seen.add(key);
00223:     out.push(d);
00224:   }
00225: 
00226:   return out;
00227: }

00239: export function auditCountsByGrupo(drawsRaw, options = {}) {
00240:   // ✅ blindagem: evita inflação por draw duplicado
00241:   const draws = dedupeDraws(drawsRaw);
00242: 
00243:   const posOpt = options?.position;
00244:   const positionFilter =
00245:     posOpt === null || posOpt === undefined || posOpt === ""
00246:       ? null
00247:       : Number(posOpt);
00248: 
00249:   const matchHourOnly = Boolean(options?.matchHourOnly); // default: false
00250: 
00251:   // normaliza filtro de hora; se inválido, ignora para não "zerar" por engano
00252:   const rawHourFilter = normalizeHourLike(options?.hour);
00253:   let hourFilter = rawHourFilter;
00254: 
00255:   if (hourFilter != null) {
00256:     if (matchHourOnly) {
00257:       const hh = String(hourFilter).slice(0, 2);
00258:       if (!/^\d{2}$/.test(hh)) hourFilter = null;
00259:     } else {
00260:       if (!isValidHHMM(hourFilter)) hourFilter = null;
00261:     }
00262:   }
00263: 
00264:   const counts = new Map(); // "01" -> count
00265:   const integrityIssues = [];
00266:   let totalOcorrencias = 0;
00267: 
00268:   for (const d of draws || []) {
00269:     const prizes = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : [];
00270: 
00271:     // normaliza close_hour do draw (se existir)
00272:     const drawHour = normalizeHourLike(extractRawCloseHourFromDraw(d));
00273: 
00274:     for (const p of prizes) {
00275:       const gNum = Number(p?.grupo ?? p?.group);
00276:       if (!Number.isFinite(gNum) || gNum < 1 || gNum > 25) continue;
00277: 
00278:       // filtro por posição (se aplicado)
00279:       if (positionFilter != null) {
00280:         const pos = Number(p?.posicao ?? p?.position ?? 0);
00281:         if (!Number.isFinite(pos) || pos !== positionFilter) continue;
00282:       }
00283: 
00284:       // filtro por horário (se aplicado e válido)
00285:       if (hourFilter != null) {
00286:         if (!drawHour) continue;
00287: 
00288:         if (matchHourOnly) {
00289:           const hhDraw = String(drawHour).slice(0, 2);
00290:           const hhFilter = String(hourFilter).slice(0, 2);
00291:           if (hhDraw !== hhFilter) continue;
00292:         } else {
00293:           if (drawHour !== hourFilter) continue;
00294:         }
00295:       }
00296: 
00297:       const g = pad2(gNum);
00298: 
00299:       // integridade: grupo deve bater com animal oficial (quando animal existir no dado)
00300:       const bicho = safeGetBichoByGrupo(gNum);
00301:       const animalBase = bicho ? safeNormalizeAnimal(bicho.animal) : "";
00302: 
00303:       const rawAnimal = String(p?.animal ?? "");
00304:       // se vier mojibake/corrompido (ex.: "Le├úo", "Jacar├®"), ignora a checagem
00305:       const animalFromData = /[├ÃÂ�]/.test(rawAnimal)
00306:         ? ""
00307:         : safeNormalizeAnimal(rawAnimal);
00308: 
00309:       if (animalFromData && animalBase && animalFromData !== animalBase) {
00310:         integrityIssues.push({
00311:           date: extractRawDateFromDraw(d) || null,
00312:           date_ymd: normalizeToYMD(extractRawDateFromDraw(d)),
00313:           close_hour: extractRawCloseHourFromDraw(d) || null,
00314:           close_hour_norm: drawHour,
00315:           grupo: g,
00316:           animal_no_dado: p?.animal || "",
00317:           animal_oficial: bicho?.animal || "",
00318:           position: p?.posicao ?? p?.position ?? null,
00319:         });
00320:       }
00321: 
00322:       counts.set(g, (counts.get(g) || 0) + 1);
00323:       totalOcorrencias += 1;
00324:     }
00325:   }
00326: 
00327:   // 01..25 sem sort (auditoria “linha a linha”)
00328:   const rowsByGrupo = Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => {
00329:     const grupo = pad2(i + 1);
00330:     const val = counts.get(grupo) || 0;
00331:     const bicho = safeGetBichoByGrupo(i + 1);
00332: 
00333:     return {
00334:       grupo,
00335:       animal: bicho?.animal || "",
00336:       apar: val,
00337:       share: totalOcorrencias
00338:         ? `${Number((val / totalOcorrencias) * 100).toFixed(2)}%`
00339:         : "0.00%",
00340:     };
00341:   });
00342: 
00343:   // ranking desc (para UI)
00344:   const rowsSorted = [...rowsByGrupo].sort((a, b) => b.apar - a.apar);
00345: 
00346:   return {
00347:     rows: rowsSorted, // compat (UI)
00348:     rowsByGrupo, // auditoria 01..25
00349:     totalOcorrencias,
00350:     integrityIssues,
00351:     appliedFilters: {
00352:       position:
00353:         positionFilter != null && Number.isFinite(positionFilter)
00354:           ? positionFilter
00355:           : null,

00357:       matchHourOnly,

00359:   };
00360: }

00388: export function auditDatasetSummary(drawsRaw, options = {}) {
00389:   const draws = dedupeDraws(drawsRaw);
00390:   const sampleLimit = Number(options?.sampleLimit ?? 20);
00391: 
00392:   let drawsWithPrizes = 0;
00393:   let drawsWithoutPrizes = 0;
00394: 
00395:   let prizesTotal = 0;
00396: 
00397:   let invalidDateCount = 0;
00398:   let invalidCloseHourCount = 0;
00399: 
00400:   let invalidGrupoCount = 0;
00401:   let missingGrupoCount = 0;
00402: 
00403:   let missingPositionCount = 0;
00404:   let invalidPositionCount = 0;
00405: 
00406:   for (const d of draws) {
00407:     const prizes = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : [];
00408: 
00409:     if (prizes.length) drawsWithPrizes += 1;
00410:     else drawsWithoutPrizes += 1;
00411: 
00412:     const ymd = normalizeToYMD(extractRawDateFromDraw(d));
00413:     if (!ymd) invalidDateCount += 1;
00414: 
00415:     const hhmm = normalizeHourLike(extractRawCloseHourFromDraw(d));
00416:     if (!hhmm || !isValidHHMM(hhmm)) invalidCloseHourCount += 1;
00417: 
00418:     prizesTotal += prizes.length;
00419: 
00420:     for (const p of prizes) {
00421:       const gNum = Number(p?.grupo ?? p?.group);
00422:       if (!Number.isFinite(gNum)) {
00423:         missingGrupoCount += 1;
00424:       } else if (gNum < 1 || gNum > 25) {
00425:         invalidGrupoCount += 1;
00426:       }
00427: 
00428:       const posRaw = p?.posicao ?? p?.position;
00429:       if (posRaw === null || posRaw === undefined || posRaw === "") {
00430:         missingPositionCount += 1;
00431:       } else {
00432:         const pos = Number(posRaw);
00433:         if (!Number.isFinite(pos) || pos < 1 || pos > 10) {
00434:           invalidPositionCount += 1;
00435:         }
00436:       }
00437:     }
00438:   }
00439: 
00440:   const byGrupo = auditCountsByGrupo(draws, {
00441:     position: options?.position ?? null,
00442:     hour: options?.hour ?? null,
00443:     matchHourOnly: options?.matchHourOnly ?? false,
00444:   });
00445: 
00446:   const animalMismatchCount = byGrupo.integrityIssues.length;
00447:   const integrityIssuesSample = byGrupo.integrityIssues.slice(
00448:     0,
00449:     Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(sampleLimit) ? sampleLimit : 20)
00450:   );
00451: 
00452:   const totals = computeDrawTotals(draws);
00453: 
00454:   return {
00455:     totals: {
00456:       draws: draws.length,
00457:       uniqueDays: totals.uniqueDays,
00458:       drawsWithPrizes,
00459:       drawsWithoutPrizes,
00460:       prizesTotal,
00461:     },
00462:     issues: {
00463:       invalidDateCount,
00464:       invalidCloseHourCount,
00465:       missingGrupoCount,
00466:       invalidGrupoCount,
00467:       missingPositionCount,
00468:       invalidPositionCount,
00469:       animalMismatchCount,
00470:     },
00471:     byGrupo: {
00472:       rowsByGrupo: byGrupo.rowsByGrupo,
00473:       rowsSorted: byGrupo.rows,

00011: export async function safeGetDocsSmart(qRef, { policy = "cache" } = {}) {
00012:   const p = String(policy || "cache").toLowerCase();
00013: 
00014:   if (p === "server") {
00015:     try {
00016:       const snap = await getDocsFromServer(qRef);
00017:       return { snap, error: null, source: "server" };
00018:     } catch (e) {
00019:       try {
00020:         const snap = await getDocs(qRef);
00021:         return { snap, error: null, source: "cache_fallback" };
00022:       } catch (e2) {
00023:         return { snap: null, error: e2, source: "error" };
00024:       }
00025:     }
00026:   }
00027: 
00028:   try {
00029:     const snapCache = await getDocs(qRef);
00030:     if (snapCache?.docs?.length) {
00031:       return { snap: snapCache, error: null, source: "cache" };
00032:     }
00033: 
00034:     try {
00035:       const snapServer = await getDocsFromServer(qRef);
00036:       return { snap: snapServer, error: null, source: "server_fallback" };
00037:     } catch (_e2) {
00038:       return { snap: snapCache, error: null, source: "cache_empty" };
00039:     }
00040:   } catch (_e) {
00041:     try {
00042:       const snap = await getDocsFromServer(qRef);
00043:       return { snap, error: null, source: "server_after_cache_error" };
00044:     } catch (e2) {
00045:       return { snap: null, error: e2, source: "error" };
00046:     }
00047:   }
00048: }

00264: function resolveHourFilter({ closeHour = null, closeHourBucket = null }) {
00265:   const bucket = toHourBucket(closeHourBucket);
00266:   if (bucket) return { kind: "bucket", bucket, hhmm: null };

00268:   const hhmm = closeHour ? normalizeHourLike(closeHour) : null;
00269:   if (hhmm) return { kind: "exact", bucket: null, hhmm };

00271:   return { kind: null, bucket: null, hhmm: null };

00321: function sortDrawsLocal(draws) {
00322:   const toNum = (h) => {
00323:     const s = normalizeHourLike(h);
00324:     const m = s.match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
00325:     if (!m) return 0;
00326:     return Number(m[1]) * 100 + Number(m[2]);
00327:   };
00328: 
00329:   return [...(draws || [])].sort((a, b) => {
00330:     const ya = String(a?.ymd || "");
00331:     const yb = String(b?.ymd || "");
00332:     if (ya !== yb) return ya.localeCompare(yb);
00333: 
00334:     const ha = toNum(a?.close_hour);
00335:     const hb = toNum(b?.close_hour);
00336:     if (ha !== hb) return ha - hb;
00337: 
00338:     const la = normalizeLotteryCodeAny(a);
00339:     const lb = normalizeLotteryCodeAny(b);
00340:     if (la !== lb) return la.localeCompare(lb);
00341: 
00342:     const ia = String(a?.drawId || a?.id || "");
00343:     const ib = String(b?.drawId || b?.id || "");
00344:     return ia.localeCompare(ib);
00345:   });
00346: }

00375: /**
00376:  * ✅ DEDUPE
00377:  * - chave lógica: ymd + hour (+ lottery_code quando existir)
00378:  * - se não houver ymd/hour, cai no id/idx
00379:  *
00380:  * ✅ FIX CRÍTICO:
00381:  * Não colapsar dois draws distintos do mesmo dia/horário com lottery_code diferente.
00382:  */
00383: function dedupeDrawsLocal(draws) {
00384:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00385: 
00386:   const byKey = new Map();
00387:   const order = [];
00388: 
00389:   function score(d) {
00390:     const prizesLen = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes.length : 0;
00391:     const pc = Number.isFinite(Number(d?.prizesCount))
00392:       ? Number(d.prizesCount)
00393:       : 0;
00394:     const hasLogical = !!(d?.ymd && d?.close_hour);
00395:     return prizesLen * 1_000_000 + pc * 1_000 + (hasLogical ? 10 : 0);
00396:   }
00397: 
00398:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00399:     const raw = arr[i] || {};
00400: 
00401:     const ymd = raw.ymd || normalizeToYMD(raw.date) || "";
00402:     const hour = normalizeHourLike(raw.close_hour || raw.closeHour || "");
00403: 
00404:     const lotCode = normalizeLotteryCodeAny(raw);
00405: 
00406:     const drawId = raw.drawId ?? raw.id ?? raw.__name__ ?? null;
00407:     const idStr = drawId != null ? String(drawId) : "";
00408: 
00409:     const hasLogical = !!(ymd && hour);
00410: 
00411:     const key = hasLogical
00412:       ? lotCode
00413:         ? `${ymd}__${hour}__${lotCode}`
00414:         : `${ymd}__${hour}`
00415:       : `id__${idStr || `idx_${i}`}`;
00416: 
00417:     const normalized = {
00418:       ...raw,
00419:       ymd: ymd || raw.ymd || null,
00420:       close_hour: hour || raw.close_hour || raw.closeHour || "",
00421:       closeHour: hour || raw.closeHour || raw.close_hour || "",
00422:       lottery_code: lotCode || raw.lottery_code || raw.lotteryCode || null,
00423:       drawId: raw.drawId || raw.id || raw.__name__ || null,
00424:       id: raw.id || raw.drawId || raw.__name__ || null,
00425:     };
00426: 
00427:     if (!byKey.has(key)) {
00428:       byKey.set(key, normalized);
00429:       order.push(key);
00430:       continue;
00431:     }
00432: 
00433:     const prev = byKey.get(key);
00434:     if (score(normalized) > score(prev)) {
00435:       byKey.set(key, normalized);
00436:     }
00437:   }
00438: 
00439:   return order.map((k) => byKey.get(k)).filter(Boolean);
00440: }

00442: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00443:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00444:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 6);
00445:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00446:   let idx = 0;
00447: 
00448:   async function worker() {
00449:     while (true) {
00450:       const current = idx;
00451:       idx += 1;
00452:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
00453:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00454:     }
00455:   }
00456: 
00457:   await Promise.all(
00458:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
00459:   );
00460:   return results;
00461: }

01026: function federalHourPriority(draw) {
01027:   const h = normalizeHourLike(
01028:     draw?.close_hour || draw?.closeHour || draw?.hour || draw?.hora || ""
01029:   );
01030:   const ymd = String(draw?.ymd || normalizeToYMD(draw?.date) || "").trim();
01031:   const n = hourToNumSafe(h);
01032: 
01033:   const prefer20h = getFederalPreferredHourForYmd(ymd) === "20:00";
01034: 
01035:   if (prefer20h) {
01036:     if (h === "20:00") return 200000 + n;
01037:     if (h === "19:00") return 190000 + n;
01038:     return 100000 + n;
01039:   }
01040: 
01041:   if (h === "19:00") return 200000 + n;
01042:   if (h === "20:00") return 190000 + n;
01043:   return 100000 + n;
01044: }

01046: function pickBetterFederalClone(a, b) {
01047:   const pa = Number.isFinite(Number(a?.prizesCount))
01048:     ? Number(a.prizesCount)
01049:     : Array.isArray(a?.prizes)
01050:     ? a.prizes.length
01051:     : 0;
01052: 
01053:   const pb = Number.isFinite(Number(b?.prizesCount))
01054:     ? Number(b.prizesCount)
01055:     : Array.isArray(b?.prizes)
01056:     ? b.prizes.length
01057:     : 0;
01058: 
01059:   if (pa !== pb) return pb > pa ? b : a;
01060: 
01061:   const ha = federalHourPriority(a);
01062:   const hb = federalHourPriority(b);
01063:   if (ha !== hb) return hb > ha ? b : a;
01064: 
01065:   const ia = String(a?.drawId || a?.id || "");
01066:   const ib = String(b?.drawId || b?.id || "");
01067:   return ib.localeCompare(ia) > 0 ? b : a;
01068: }

01070: function collapseFederalDailyCloneDraws(draws) {
01071:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
01072:   const byKey = new Map();
01073: 
01074:   for (const d of arr) {
01075:     const ymd = String(d?.ymd || normalizeToYMD(d?.date) || "").trim();
01076:     const sig = buildPrizeSignature(d);
01077: 
01078:     if (!ymd || !sig) {
01079:       const fallbackKey = `id::${String(
01080:         d?.drawId || d?.id || Math.random()
01081:       )}`;
01082:       if (!byKey.has(fallbackKey)) byKey.set(fallbackKey, d);
01083:       continue;
01084:     }
01085: 
01086:     const key = `${ymd}__${sig}`;
01087:     const prev = byKey.get(key);
01088: 
01089:     if (!prev) byKey.set(key, d);
01090:     else byKey.set(key, pickBetterFederalClone(prev, d));
01091:   }
01092: 
01093:   return sortDrawsLocal(Array.from(byKey.values()));
01094: }

01606: export async function getKingLateByRange({
01607:   uf,

01664:     return outEmpty;
01665:   }
01666: 
01667:   while (cursorTo >= fromYmd && lastSeen.size < 25) {
01668:     let chunkFrom = addDaysUTC(cursorTo, -(chunk - 1));
01669:     if (chunkFrom < fromYmd) chunkFrom = fromYmd;
01670: 
01671:     const draws = await getKingResultsByRange({
01672:       uf,

01674:       dateTo: cursorTo,
01675:       closeHour,

01678:       mode: "detailed",
01679:     });

01682:

01706:           lottery_code: d.lottery_code || null,

01712:

01714:   }
01715: 
01716:   const rows = [];

01731:       atrasoDias,

01733:   }

01736:     const aa = Number.isFinite(Number(a?.atrasoDias)) ? Number(a.atrasoDias) : -1;
01737:     const bb = Number.isFinite(Number(b?.atrasoDias)) ? Number(b.atrasoDias) : -1;
01738:     if (bb !== aa) return bb - aa;
01739: 
01740:     const ha = hourToNumSafe(a?.lastHour);
01741:     const hb = hourToNumSafe(b?.lastHour);
01742:     if (ha !== hb) return ha - hb;

00166:       },
00167:       { merge: true }
00168:     );
00169:

00134: /**
00135:  * ✅ DEDUP DE DRAWS (CORREÇÃO CRÍTICA)
00136:  * - Prioriza a chave LÓGICA (ymd + close_hour) para eliminar duplicidade real
00137:  * - Só cai para id/drawId se NÃO conseguir montar (ymd/hour)
00138:  * - Se ainda assim ficar sem chave, usa fallback com índice (não colapsa tudo em "__")
00139:  */
00140: function dedupeDraws(draws) {
00141:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00142:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
00143: 
00144:   const seen = new Set();
00145:   const out = [];
00146: 
00147:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00148:     const d = arr[i];
00149: 
00150:     const ymd =
00151:       String(d?.ymd || "").trim() ||
00152:       normalizeToYMD(getDrawYmdRaw(d)) ||
00153:       "";
00154: 
00155:     const hour = getDrawHourRaw(d);
00156: 
00157:     const logicalKey = ymd && hour ? `${ymd}__${hour}` : "";
00158:     const fallbackKey =
00159:       (d?.drawId != null && String(d.drawId)) ||
00160:       (d?.id != null && String(d.id)) ||
00161:       "";
00162: 
00163:     const key = logicalKey || fallbackKey || `${ymd || "nodate"}__${hour || "nohour"}__idx${i}`;
00164: 
00165:     if (seen.has(key)) continue;
00166:     seen.add(key);
00167:     out.push(d);
00168:   }
00169: 
00170:   return out;
00171: }

00561: async function fetchDayStatusFromBackend({ date, lottery }) {
00562:   try {
00563:     const base = PITACO_API_BASE.replace(/\/+$/, "");
00564:     const u = `${base}/api/pitaco/results?date=${encodeURIComponent(String(date || "").trim())}&lottery=${encodeURIComponent(
00565:       String(lottery || "").trim()
00566:     )}`;
00567: 
00568:     const res = await axios.get(u, {
00569:       timeout: 15000,
00570:       validateStatus: (s) => s >= 200 && s < 400,
00571:       headers: { "User-Agent": "palpitaco-autoImportToday" },
00572:     });
00573: 
00574:     const j = res && res.data ? res.data : null;
00575:     if (!j || typeof j !== "object") return null;
00576: 
00577:     return {
00578:       ok: Boolean(j.ok),
00579:       dayStatus: String(j.dayStatus || "").trim(),
00580:       blocked: Boolean(j.blocked),
00581:       blockedReason: String(j.blockedReason || "").trim(),
00582:       count: Number.isFinite(Number(j.count)) ? Number(j.count) : null,
00583: 
00584:       // ✅ debug (não é fonte da verdade pro FEDERAL fixed)
00585:       expectedHard: Array.isArray(j.expectedHard) ? j.expectedHard.map(String) : [],
00586:       expectedSoft: Array.isArray(j.expectedSoft) ? j.expectedSoft.map(String) : [],
00587:       presentHours: Array.isArray(j.presentHours) ? j.presentHours.map(String) : [],
00588: 
00589:       // debug útil
00590:       slotsSummary: j.slotsSummary ?? null,
00591:       slots: Array.isArray(j.slots) ? j.slots : [],
00592:     };
00593:   } catch {
00594:     return null;
00595:   }
00596: }

00598: function applyHolidayNoDrawToState({ state, statusMap, isoNow }) {
00599:   let touched = 0;
00600: 
00601:   for (const sched of SCHEDULE) {
00602:     let slot = state?.[sched.hour];
00603: 
00604:     if (!slot) {
00605:       slot = { hour: sched.hour, done: false, na: false, tries: 0 };
00606:       state[sched.hour] = slot;
00607:     }
00608: 
00609:     const st = statusMap.get(sched.hour) || "OFF";
00610:     const applies = st === "HARD" || st === "SOFT";
00611:     if (!applies) continue;
00612: 
00613:     if (slot.done && slot.na && slot.naReason === "HOLIDAY_NO_DRAW") continue;
00614: 
00615:     slot.done = true;
00616:     slot.na = true;
00617:     slot.naReason = "HOLIDAY_NO_DRAW";
00618:     slot.lastTryISO = isoNow;
00619:     slot.lastResult = { ok: true, skipped: true, reason: "HOLIDAY_NO_DRAW" };
00620:     touched += 1;
00621:   }
00622: 
00623:   return touched;
00624: }

00787: /**
00788:  * Reconcilia o state temporário do runner com os horários
00789:  * realmente presentes no backend/Firestore.

00791: function syncStateFromBackendSnapshot({
00792:   state,
00793:   statusMap,
00794:   daySnapshot,
00795:   isoNow,
00796: }) {
00797:   const rawPresentHours = Array.isArray(daySnapshot?.presentHours)
00798:     ? daySnapshot.presentHours
00799:     : [];
00800: 
00801:   const presentHours = new Set(
00802:     rawPresentHours
00803:       .map((value) => {
00804:         const match = String(value ?? "").trim().match(/(\d{1,2})/);
00805:         if (!match) return "";
00806: 
00807:         const hour = Number(match[1]);
00808:         if (!Number.isFinite(hour) || hour < 0 || hour > 23) return "";
00809: 
00810:         return pad2(hour);
00811:       })
00812:       .filter(Boolean)
00813:   );
00814: 
00815:   if (!presentHours.size) return 0;
00816: 
00817:   let touched = 0;
00818: 
00819:   for (const sched of SCHEDULE) {
00820:     const slot = state?.[sched.hour];
00821:     if (!slot || slot.done || slot.na) continue;
00822:
